words.def: Derives a biological noun, such as a living organism, plant, animal, or body part.
Indicates an action that occurred in the past.
Establishes that an action was completely finished before another past action occurred.
Indicates an action that was actively in progress during the past.
Derives a descriptive modifier.
The -f suffix tells the parser to act as mathematical parentheses, distributing the modifier backward across every noun connected by lan until the chain breaks.
Derives an action or a stative verb.
Indicates a completed past action that has a direct result or relevance right now.
Signals the parser to suspend the Look Left rule, allowing the next modifier to attach to this word instead of the root.
Derives a concrete noun, such as a physical object, material, tool, or location.
Explicitly identifies a known, definite entity.
Indicates an action actively in progress at this exact moment.
Indicates an indefinite, unknown, or general entity.
Indicates an action that will occur forward in time.
Sets a deadline for when a future action will be completely finished.
Describes an ongoing state at a specific point in the future.
Mathematical linker that locks adjacent words into a single syntactic block, combining single digits into multi-digit integers or permanently chaining serial verbs.
Derives an abstract noun, such as a concept, emotion, time, or intangible idea.
A powered, fixed-wing flying vehicle constructed from lightweight metals or composites.

words.english: So / To that extent / In that way
words.def: A comparative modifier used to indicate that something reaches a specifically referenced degree, extent, or manner (e.g., Why are you so angry?).
An abstract faculty of perception, logic, or structural meaning.
This word identifies a sharp, curved, horny nail situated on the digit of an animal's foot, used for gripping or tearing.
Showing a readiness to give more of something (like time, care, or wealth) than is expected.
Indicates a spatial bridge mapping movement or position from one side of a surface, boundary, or flat area to the opposite side.
To give one thing and receive another in return; to exchange goods or services with another party.
The abstract state of being awake, perceiving reality, and having a subjective, self-aware experience.
Extent, Used when referring to the how much of an abstract concept (e.g., The extent of the problem).
Running at a slant, joining opposite corners rather than following the vertical or horizontal.
A folding canopy on a metal frame, used to protect against rain or sun.
To slide accidentally or lose one's footing on a slippery surface.
To move forward close to the ground, typically on hands and knees.
The solid, powdery physical residue left behind after combustible matter has been completely consumed by fire.
The abstract conceptual system governing the production, distribution, and consumption of societal resources.
An action, decision, or judgment that is incorrect, misguided, or wrong.
To fasten, stick, or bind things together using an adhesive substance.
A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall, leading to a severe shortage of water.
This word indicates that something is very close to a specific state, quantity, or degree, but is not completely there yet.
Emitting a strong, unpleasant, or foul odor.
An open wheeled vehicle for carrying loads, pulled or pushed.
Exclamation of sudden physical pain or intense discomfort.
To cook food using dry, ambient heat in an enclosed space (like an oven) or over an open flame.
To speak, cry out, or call in a very loud voice, typically expressing strong emotion.
Indicating substitution of one entity or action for another.
At no time; not ever.
This word describes an event or state happening before the usual, expected, or planned time.
Describes an abstract concept, rule, or structural element that serves as the deep, necessary foundation or core basis from which other things develop.
This word describes an event or state happening after the usual, expected, or planned time.

The one small final addition that brings the whole to life; the opposite of lynku (ruin by overdoing). Logical equivalent: Lantiup lande fefue keanei cemup late. (The small final addition completes everything.)
Fully satisfied after eating; no longer hungry.

words.english: Divided by / Fraction of / Out of
words.def: This is an immutable mathematical operator used to perform explicit division or create fractions within a sentence. When placed between two numerical blocks, the parser evaluates the calculation first, unifying them into a single quantitative value before the result looks left to attach to a noun. It can also be used in a Zero Copula sentence to state a mathematical equation (e.g., sluqe ap dewe tafe = 6 divided by 2 is 3).
A structural preposition indicating that an action or state strictly follows the rules, statements, or nature of the target noun.
The fleshy, round fruit of a specific widely cultivated tree, typically possessing a red or green skin and a crisp interior.
Conforming to a standard; usual, typical, or expected.
Pertaining to the biological sex that typically produces the mobile gametes (sperm), or relating to masculine characteristics.
To actively enter into an event, group, or activity and take part in its ongoing processes.
Highly recommended, socially expected, or logically advisable, but not strictly obligatory.
Having a child or young developing in the uterus.
A natural electrical discharge of very short duration and high voltage, accompanied by a bright flash.
To move steadily and continuously in a current or stream, as liquids, air, or crowds naturally do; ibvi (pour) is the deliberate act.
This identifies the fleshy, edible product of a tree or plant that naturally contains seeds and is consumed as food.
The conceptual expression or abstract application of human creative skill and imagination.
Pertaining to the biological sex that typically produces the larger gametes (ova), or relating to feminine characteristics.
The abstract intellectual justification, motive, or logical premise behind an action or belief.
To fasten or secure something using a string or rope.
The abstract conceptual feeling of wanting to know/learn about something, or an intangible advantage/benefit.
A firmly held abstract understanding, principle, or conceptual truth that a person accepts as real, even without absolute physical proof.
An abstract domain of study, specific area of conceptual interest, or theoretical sphere of activity.
A connected series of physical railway carriages or wagons structurally linked and moved by a locomotive engine along tracks.
To go down below the surface of a liquid, or fall slowly toward the bottom.
No longer fresh or pleasant; spoiled, decomposed, or organic matter that has broken down.
In a line parallel with, or next to the length of a surface or path.
A small, thin, pointed piece of metal with a flat head, driven into wood or other materials to hold them together.
To intentionally or accidentally release a physical object from one's grasp, allowing gravity to pull it down.
A hill of wind-blown sand.
An interconnected system or group of things, people, or devices.
A union or association formed for mutual benefit, especially between groups, factions, or countries.
This refers to an abstract constraint, principle, or guideline governing conduct or action.
Feelings of pity, sorrow, or shared concern for someone else's misfortune or pain.
A deep, rounded physical container used for holding liquids or food.
This describes a biological state of discomfort or weakness caused by a lack of food, coupled with a strong desire to eat.
A sign that something, especially something bad, is coming.
This refers to the base unit of time, equal to one-sixtieth of a minute.
The inner, flat surface of the hand, between the wrist and the fingers.
To temporarily take or receive physical possession of something with the strict intention of returning it to its owner.
To execute an action with the intent of achieving a specific result, while acknowledging that the outcome is uncertain or experimental.
A soft, porous object that soaks up and holds liquid, used for washing and cleaning.
A light, gentle wind, weaker than a strong wind (xabeso).
This verb means to cry out to someone in order to summon them or attract their attention.
Doing things without care or precision. Logical equivalent: Daq naci neswy zenup. (He works without care.)
Any organic, nutritious matter consumed or absorbed by a living organism to sustain life and growth.
This word describes a state possessing physical or conceptual qualities that give immense, positive aesthetic pleasure to the senses.
Indicates a spatial bridge where the subject is located at or directed toward the rear or back of a reference point.
To block an opening, seal a passage, or restrict physical access.
To form fabric, a web, or a net by interlacing threads or strands.
Clausal wall introducing an independent parallel thought; completely resets the SVO parser.
The sweet, golden, viscous food produced by bees (elsa) from flower nectar.
A relative degree modifier indicating a small, minor, or low amount of a trait, state, or action.
This identifies the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.
A physical covering for the foot, typically made of leather or synthetic materials, featuring a sturdy protective sole.
Indicates a spatial or logical bridge mapping a position that is strictly past the physical limits, boundary, or scope of the reference point.
The invisible mixture of gases surrounding a planet or filling an environment.
A very young human child, particularly one who has not yet learned to walk or talk.
A fermented, carbonated physical liquid beverage typically brewed from malted barley and flavored with hops.
Explicitly permitted or allowed.
To officially prepare and issue a book, journal, piece of media, or statement for broad public distribution.
A brewed magical liquid prepared in small quantities and drunk to produce a specific effect on the body or mind.
This refers to the lowest cardinal number, representing a single unit or entity.
Monday; the first day of the week. Derived by compounding bime (one) and du (day).
A pragmatic mood tag placed at the absolute start of a sentence to introduce the first point in a sequence.
This refers to a matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful and needing to be dealt with and overcome.
A conceptual human organization or structural enterprise legally engaged in commercial, industrial, or professional activities.
A block of cast metal, typically shaped for storage or working.
A tool or weapon with a heavy bladed head on a handle, used for chopping.
A tiny organism that causes disease.
This refers to the semantic intent, logical significance, or intended message behind a word, action, or concept.
The joint connecting the hand to the forearm.
This refers to strength or energy as an attribute of physical action or movement, or an influence that can change the motion of an object.
This identifies the red liquid that circulates in the arteries and veins of humans and other vertebrate animals.
Regarded as subjectively negative or unfavorable.
To identify a disease from its signs.
Regular money paid to a person after they stop working.
A deep metal cooking vessel used over heat; the basic kitchen container for boiling and stewing.
To move or act with haste; to do something quickly or hastily, or to urge another to do so.
This describes an entity possessing a low mental capacity, or lacking logic, reasoning, and good judgment.
A physically constructed vessel designed to float and travel on the surface of water.
To crush and grind food between the teeth before swallowing.
A large black-and-white bear native to bamboo forests.
The upper front part of the face, above the eyebrows and below the hairline.
The joint connecting the upper arm to the forearm.
A feeling of sadness, repentance, or disappointment over something that has happened or been done.
A large body of water surrounded by land. Follows xadoro (river) and tandorso (ocean) as a specific water-body type.
A staple food made by baking a dough of ground grain, water, and typically a leavening agent.
The planet on which we live, taken as a proper name; the third planet from the sun.
A reddish-orange metal, used in wiring, tools, and alloys. Follows xedo (metal) and xaqbo (gold) as a specific metal type.
Clausal wall introducing a contrasting thought or exception.
To express dissatisfaction, annoyance, or grievance about something. A speech-act verb alongside akdi (shout) and opdi (whisper).
A place where medicines are prepared and sold.
This refers to items worn to cover the body, typically made of fabric or textile materials.
This identifies a large domesticated ungulate kept primarily as livestock for the production of meat or milk.
Showing a tendency to be quickly irritated or provoked by delays, obstacles, or opposition.
A device that detects and measures a physical condition.
To produce a continuous low vibrating sound, as an insect's wings or a running machine does.
Used to indicate agent, means, or source.
Every one of a group considered individually, one by one.
This refers to the region of the atmosphere and outer space seen from the earth.
The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.
This word refers strictly to a human being in the biological stage of life between birth and puberty.
A paved public thoroughfare in a city or town, serving as a physical infrastructure route for vehicles and pedestrians.
To move swiftly on foot at a pace significantly faster than a walk.
The dark physical area or shape structurally created on a surface when an opaque object blocks a light source (lito).
This word indicates the purpose, destination, or intended recipient of an action or object.
Clausal wall introducing a subsequent chronological action; resolves a conditional premise.
The abstract social structure, shared identity, or conceptual bond uniting a group of individuals.
This word describes the very darkest color, resulting from the absence or complete absorption of light.
This refers strictly to a young male human who has not yet reached adulthood.
An abstract conceptual step, planned maneuver, or clever method executed to gain an advantage or achieve a specific goal within a system or game.
This refers strictly to a young female human who has not yet reached adulthood.
This refers to a small, domesticated carnivorous mammal, widely kept as a companion animal.
The net of fine silk threads spun by a spider to catch prey.
A latent capacity or possibility that has not yet been realized.
Expresses politeness, courteous intent, or softens a command.
Belonging to or for the use of one particular person or group only; not public.
A universal substantive used to refer to any abstract entity, concept, idea, or matter of discussion.
This verb means to remain alive or have life.
A moving ridge on the surface of water.
To intentionally make a physical object, concept, or data visually or intellectually apparent to another entity.
A section of a felled tree trunk or thick branch.
This describes an action or state that has been fully completed or achieved prior to a specific point in time.
The distinctive moral and mental qualities of a person or thing.
Belonging to, coming from, or characteristic of another country, language, or society.
This refers to the early part of the day, typically from sunrise until the midpoint of the day.
A physical tool, instrument, or device specifically engineered to inflict bodily harm or structural damage.
This identifies the flattened, usually green structure of a plant attached to a stem.
This verb means to begin an action or event.
To produce short, high-pitched sounds, as small birds and small animals do.
The rhythmic daily rise and fall of the sea.
A large cylindrical container with bulging sides and flat ends, traditionally of wooden staves bound by hoops.
Money paid in advance as security or placed into an account.
A mechanical or electrical physical device constructed with a dial or display for mathematically measuring and showing time.
A thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface that obscures or restricts visibility.
This word describes a small number or amount of something.
To burst apart suddenly and violently with a release of energy, noise, and force.
This word describes something occurring, found, or done frequently; highly prevalent in the environment.
To cause a device, system, or function to stop operating. The antonym of leoci (to turn on / activate).
A primate, typically having a tail and living in trees in tropical regions.
This refers to the thin layer of tissue forming the natural outer covering of the body.
This verb means to separate or divide something using a sharp edge.
A domesticated pack animal related to the horse, smaller and long-eared.
A large, heavy mammal with thick fur and a very short tail.
A perfectly round three-dimensional body, every surface point equally distant from the center; the geometric shape, where weoro (ball) is the play object.
A large wild canine that hunts in packs.
The abstract conceptual target or desired future outcome toward which systematic effort is directed.
A piece of soft rubber or plastic used to rub out ink or pencil marks.

Describes an indefinite, non-zero quantity or subset of an entity. Mathematically, it asserts that a quantity exists (strictly greater than zero) but explicitly leaves the exact number undefined, stripping away any subjective judgment of whether it is few or many.
To engage in a physical, verbal, or conceptual struggle against an opposing force or entity.
Small water droplets that form on cool surfaces overnight.
This word describes a state or object belonging strictly to the present timeframe; happening or being actively used right now.
A malevolent supernatural being; a demon.
A light or fire set in a high, visible place to signal, warn, or guide from a distance.
This word describes an entity in a fully prepared and suitable state to immediately begin an action or activity.
To move through the air or space under control, whether by aerodynamic wings, biological capability, or mechanical propulsion.
A small settlement of houses and inhabitants in the countryside; smaller than juro (city).
The grammatical word class marking a relation between a noun and the rest of the sentence, marked by the functional vowel -y. A category-classification concept, following aziku (rule).
A person who is unknown to the speaker; someone with whom one has no prior acquaintance or familiarity.
The sandy or rocky boundary where land meets a large body of water.
A specialized field of study or expertise.
This word refers to the internal muscular organ in which the first major part of the physical digestion of food occurs.

To accept a proposition as true without evidence, as a working basis for reasoning or action; differs from atilui (believe), which carries conviction, and from ubli (expect), which is directed at a future event.
This refers to the relative worth, merit, or importance of a thing; or a numerical quantity assigned to a symbol or variable.
Third-person singular animate neutral; an entity with intent or agency where gender is unspecified or irrelevant.
Strictly belonging to or associated with a person or animal where gender is unspecified or irrelevant.
A period of rest and leisure away from work, study, or routine; a holiday or vacation.
Third-person singular animate male; a male entity with intent or agency.
Strictly belonging to or associated with a specific male person or animal.
Third-person singular animate female; a female entity with intent or agency.
Strictly belonging to or associated with a specific female person or animal.

words.english: Due to / As a result of / Because of
words.def: A structural bridge linking an outcome strictly to the noun that caused it.
A thin layer of ice crystals that forms on cold surfaces.
An abstract psychological stance, settled way of thinking, or behavioral disposition toward a specific entity or situation.
The short, thick first digit of the hand, opposable to the other four fingers.
A piece of furniture consisting of a flat physical top supported by one or more legs, used as a surface for working or eating.
Used for location within an enclosure.
A plan of how available money will be spent.
To physically arrange, place, or establish something in a fixed, specific state.
An abstract conceptual division, academic faculty, or specialized branch within a larger institutional or corporate system.
This refers to a domesticated, carnivorous land-dwelling animal, typically kept as a companion or for work.
This refers to the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one.
Tuesday; the second day of the week. Derived by compounding dewe (two) and du (day).
Phatic greeting used in the morning; 'good morning.' Standalone on the Null Track (Rule 33).
A solid cube or rectangular unit of material; the basic building unit.
Mathematically or logically guaranteed to happen.
This defines the state of matter that flows freely but is of constant volume.
This defines the state of matter characterized by structural rigidity and resistance to force.
A registered identity within a system, holding a user's access, data, and history.
This refers to the indefinite continued progress of existence and events.
An outcome that requires both parties. Logical equivalent: Epiwup sile koci nofa dewe. (This action needs two people.)
This defines the state of matter that expands freely to fill any available space.
A large, carnivorous fish with a cartilaginous skeleton and multiple rows of teeth.
The complete connected frame of bones (meka) that supports a body; also the animated bone-creature of folklore.
This word represents the entire universe or the broad context in which things exist.
A physical building, room, or tribunal where legal cases are heard and justice is administered.
This verb means to not prevent an action from occurring.
This identifies precipitating liquid water falling downward from clouds in the atmosphere to the ground.
A person forced to flee their homeland for safety.
This refers to the rear surface of a human body from the shoulders to the hips, or the equivalent upper structural surface of an animal.
To actively propel oneself through liquid.
This serves as the prototype word for liquid matter and the substance essential for life.
A piece of nonfiction writing forming an independent part of a publication.
This word describes something having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks.
The soft curly fiber forming the coat of sheep and similar animals, used as a textile material.
This refers to the cardinal number equivalent to ten times ten.
A circular solid object designed to revolve on an axle, fixed below a vehicle or inside a machine to enable kinetic movement.
This denotes the hard, solid mineral material that is part of the earth's surface.
To go up, ascend, or scale something, typically using both hands and feet.
To change something between two alternative states, such as on and off.
A period of time from sunrise to sunrise; current day.

words.english: Spawn / Be Born / Come Into Existence
words.def: To come into existence or enter the world at a specific place and moment, whether by birth, hatching, or sudden appearance.
A smooth, highly reflective surface (typically glass with a metallic backing) that forms a clear image of objects in front of it.
This refers to the period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.
A sharp, hard, pointed structure growing on the stem or branch of a plant, serving as a natural defense.
A person who moves into a country to settle.
This refers to a period of time equal to sixty seconds or one-sixtieth of an hour.
This describes an entity extending far down from the top surface or having a great internal vertical dimension.
Indicates a temporal bridge, mapping an action strictly to the timeframe of an ongoing event or period.
To use force against something or someone in an attempt to harm or overcome; to assault.
A long, flat, sawn piece of wood.
This refers to the fleshy muscular organ in the mouth used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and speaking.
A configured value or preference that governs how something behaves; the state a thing is set to.
To mathematically or logically align with another entity's opinion, statement, or abstract state.
Vessels and objects shaped from clay and hardened by fire.
The grammatical word class denoting action or state, marked by the functional vowel -i. A category-classification concept, following aziku (rule) as an abstract linguistic term.
A person who holds sovereign authority over a state; king = + aqe, queen = + ase.

To present the outward appearance of a property or state while the speaker withholds commitment to its truth; takes a bare modifier or noun complement like the Zero Copula (Daq dzuripi goile = 'He seems sad'). The verb counterpart of udzidu (appearance); distinct from the nop evidential tag, which marks the speaker's inference rather than the subject's appearance.
To wear away gradually by the action of wind, water, or time.
A hard-shelled edible seed or fruit kernel, eaten as food or used in cooking.
A long, legless, carnivorous reptile of the suborder Serpentes.
A very small, thin terminal branch of a tree or shrub.
To successfully retrieve historical data, past events, or abstract knowledge from storage back into active memory.
To lose access to stored mental data; the systemic inability to retrieve a past event or learned concept.
A series of connected metal links or rings used for pulling, securing, or holding objects.
Willfully causing pain, distress, or suffering to others, or feeling no concern for it.
To successfully identify an entity or concept from previous experience, stored data, or memory.
Having or showing a modest estimate of one's own importance.
Strong belief, trust, or conviction in a doctrine, system, or divine creator.
To cook a physical object by completely submerging it in boiling fat or oil.
This describes an entity consistently applying a high degree of energy, focus, and dedication to a task.
The abstract conceptual measurement of physical or mental exertion required to achieve a goal.
To take another person's property without permission or legal right.
The state of agreement, concord, peaceful cooperation, or pleasing musical notes sounded together.
Not affected by alcohol or intoxicants; clear-headed.
A complex mechanical machine with moving physical parts that converts fuel or power into kinetic motion.
This refers to the cardinal number equivalent to ten times one hundred.
A long, hollow cylinder of metal, plastic, or glass, used for conveying or containing fluids or signals.
An abstract conceptual measurement of achievement, quality, or relative position on a vertical or hierarchical scale.
To pull apart or into pieces by force.
To structurally clarify data, logic, or meaning to make it perfectly comprehensible to another mind.
Free of deceit; truthful and sincere.
A stinging, winged insect known for its role in pollination and producing honey.
Newly made, harvested, or obtained; not stale, sour, or decayed.
To physically move or conceptually travel sequentially behind a target.
To intentionally or accidentally come into the physical presence of someone.
This word describes something of little weight or easy to lift.

words.english: To go inside / Come inside / Enter
words.def: To physically move from the exterior environment into the interior of an enclosure or defined space.
The abstract conceptual state or fundamental process of doing something to achieve an aim.
An enclosed compartment or heated surface used for cooking, baking, or heating food.
The abstract principle of moral rightness, equity, fairness, and the administration of law.
To rub a surface to make it smooth, shiny, and reflective.
The biological liquid naturally produced in the mouth to lubricate food and initiate physical digestion.
A loud rumbling or crashing noise heard after a lightning flash due to the rapid expansion of heated air.
To mentally comprehend the abstract meaning, logic, or underlying cause of a concept.
To expel the stomach's contents through the mouth.
A state of abstract or political conflict, competition, or severe hostility between different groups or nations.
This word describes something clearly defined, explicitly identified, or restricted to a singular, particular individual or situation.
To actively and successfully acquire, gain possession of, or secure a physical object or abstract concept. (Implies active effort or successful acquisition).
Occasionally; on some occasions but not all.
An event that happens unexpectedly and unintentionally, typically resulting in damage or injury.
An unspecified, small quantitative amount—typically more than two, but not enough to be considered many (jedle).
An abstract mathematical measure, quantity, or frequency typically measured against a separate baseline quantity.
A period of learning or teaching; a structured block of educational instruction.
To put a plan, decision, or system into effect; to carry out.
A removable cover or cap for a container, jar, or bottle.
Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of others.
This verb means to have a desire to possess or do something.
This identifies a position, area, or surface on the left or right of a central line.
This word describes something of great significance, value, or consequence.
A gender-neutral biological relative who is the child of one's parent's sibling.
To actively write down, log, or systematically record events, thoughts, or experiences that have taken place, typically for personal reflection or historical preservation.
A written or displayed series of items set out one after another. (The spoken-list separator is the particle sek.)
To officially retell, record, or communicate the factual details of events that have already taken place.
To intentionally make a person, concept, or thing known to another entity for the first time.
Structural tag placed at the clause start to mathematically invert SVO thematic roles.
This refers to a person who practices medicine and restores systemic well-being.
The abstract conceptual state of being free from physical or psychological illness; overall systemic well-being.
To contain an entity as a subordinate part or member of a larger whole or system.
To spread or publicize information widely; to propagandize.

words.english: To depend on / To rely on
words.def: To require the support, action, or existence of another entity in order to function, survive, or succeed.
This refers to a device or engine and is the essential base concept for more complex items like computers.
The abstract concept, discipline, or application of scientific knowledge, techniques, and systems for practical purposes.
Indicates abstract characteristics, personality, or intrinsic nature; having the qualities of the object.
Definition: Intensifier used to emphasize degree.
Indicates a temporal or spatial bridge extending continuously up to the absolute limit or termination point of an event or location.
This defines the final part of something or its termination point.
To formally dissolve a marital partnership, ending the spouse relation between two individuals; the reverse of jahizi (to marry).
This word describes something not the same as another or each other.
A hard, common crystalline mineral, typically white or translucent.
The collective means of mass communication.
To communicate specific information, facts, or instructions directly to another entity.
This refers to the primary daytime celestial body or central star that provides light and heat energy to a planetary system.
This verb means to combine or blend different substances together.
A person harmed by a crime or event.
The body of people employed by an organization; personnel collectively.
Abandoning a task halfway, wasting what was invested. Logical equivalent: Daq sejid jobup pary fefup. (He stopped the job before the end.)
A class or sort into which things are grouped by shared features.
To uncover something, removing what covered or protected it.
The biological organ responsible for the perception of sound.
This refers to a route, course, or track along which something moves or reaches a destination.
This word describes something of high precision, delicate physical quality, or consisting of very small particles.
The abstract programs, operational logic, and code information used by a computer system.
A thorned flowering shrub; the iconic garden flower.
A temporal modifier describing an event or action that occurred in the absolute immediate past relative to the current timeframe.
The abstract temporal realm encompassing all time and theoretical events that are yet to come.
This refers to the next day in the chronological sequence.
This refers to the principal method of human communication, consisting of words used in a structured and conventional way.
A strip of material wrapped over a wound to protect it.
The hardest known gemstone, a brilliant colorless crystal of pure carbon.
The practices that keep the body clean and healthy.
This refers to a series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end.
A body of water partly enclosed by curving land.
This describes a physical or psychological state of ease, relaxation, and pleasant contentment, free from pain or hardship.
This refers to the late part of the day, typically from the midpoint of the day until sunset.
This refers to a structure with a roof and walls, such as a house, school, store, or factory.

One's durable public standing and worth in the eyes of others, which can be given, saved, or lost. Social and lasting, unlike ofxu (inward shame) or ukwolu (momentary embarrassment). Covers the concept of 面子 (miànzi).
Indicates that the main action occurs strictly subsequent to the referenced temporal baseline or event.
The making of goods at scale; the process and output of manufacturing (distinct from sapi=make).
Distal deictic; a conceptually distant, prior, or non-current clause or concept.
This word identifies a specific physical or conceptual noun that is physically distant from the speaker, or removed from the immediate environment. It must follow the noun it modifies.
This identifies the part of a plant that attaches it to the ground and absorbs water and nourishment.
To lose or shift color, brightness, or intensity gradually; to pass smoothly from one shade into another.
This word describes something that is not under the physical control of another, not restricted, or provided without mathematical/monetary cost.
A burrowing mammal covered in bony armored plates, able to curl into a ball for defense.
A tree or shrub that grows in coastal saltwater swamps, supported by tangled above-ground roots.
To press briefly and release, as a button or a pointing device, producing a single sharp actuation.
Unable to hear; lacking the sense of hearing. Parallels nenoje (blind) as the sensory-loss modifier for hearing.
A small, long-eared mammal known for speed and burrowing.
One of the curved bones forming the cage that protects the chest cavity.
The grammatical word class that describes or modifies a noun or verb, marked by the functional vowel -e. A category-classification concept, following aziku (rule).
Sadness caused by an outcome falling below one's expectation or hope. Unlike briku (regret) it carries no self-blame, and unlike motuwu (grief) it involves no loss of an entity.
To successfully intercept and hold a physical object moving through the air, or to capture an entity that is actively fleeing.
This identifies a cold-blooded vertebrate animal with gills and fins that lives strictly and entirely in water.
The visible, tangible heat and light energy produced by active combustion.
Newly reported information about current events.
This identifies the end part of a person's arm beyond the wrist, including the palm, fingers, and thumb.

To break up and move ground or earth.

Repair Particle (Rule 39). Erases the immediately preceding word and restores the parser to the state it held before that word; may be repeated. Utterance-initial, it instead voids the single preceding utterance and a fresh clause begins. Its own word class - NOT a phatic particle and not on the Null Track (Rule 33). Cannot erase clausal walls, tep/tel, syn, mood tags or fap, and never reaches across a clause boundary.

A tool with a flat blade on a long handle, used for cultivating and weeding soil.

An interrogative modifier used to ask for the exact specification or choice between known alternatives (e.g., Which book?).

A weapon consisting of a curved stave and string, used to shoot arrows.

A small, sweet biological berry that naturally grows in clusters on a vine.

A precious gemstone of deep green color.
This verb means to maintain an upright position, supported by the feet in a vertical orientation.
A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions.

words.english: To reach / To stretch out to
words.def: To successfully stretch out to, make physical contact with, or achieve a mathematical or conceptual limit.

A remotely piloted flying machine.
To have clothing, footwear, or an accessory on the body; to be dressed in something.

To logically or emotionally pardon an offense, effectively terminating any anger, resentment, or desire for punishment toward another entity.

A thin, pliable sheet of tissue that lines, covers, or connects parts of an organism.
Free from error; in accordance with fact or truth.
An empty space, gap, or physical opening structurally present within a solid object or surface.

A gender-neutral biological relative who is the child of one's child.
A male biological relative who is the male child of one's child.

Money regularly received from work or investment.

A formal assessment of a person's knowledge, proficiency, or skills in a particular subject.
One of the two soft fleshy edges forming the opening of the mouth (ylxa); used in speech and eating.
Describes an action, state, or behavior that occurs repeatedly and characteristically over a period of time, forming an established routine or habit rather than a singular event.

The quality of having experience, knowledge, good judgment, and deep understanding of life.
Feeling tired, fatigued, and ready to fall asleep.

Having a major, measurable effect or noticeable physical/logical impact.

A single, newly formed thought, inspiration, or concept in the mind.

Exhibiting the color of the clear sky.
