This verb means to take air into the lungs and expel it.
A machine that produces electricity.
To move one's body rhythmically, often in sequence with music, to express emotion or engage in a social activity.
This refers to the female parent of a biological offspring.

The conceptual measurement, total volume, or numerical value of an entity or resource. (This is the noun form you would use to say The amount of water is high, where as wug is the grammar word used to ask What amount? / How much?).
The physical, biological muscle organ that pumps blood through the circulatory system of an organism.
he abstract conceptual center of a person, often associated with deep intuition, morality, or emotional truth. (This is the conceptual understanding of the heart).
This identifies each of the long, slender members attached to the hand.
This refers to the cardinal number equivalent to the product of two and four.
A cereal grass whose grain is ground into flour for bread; a global staple crop. Follows vyfla (rice) as a specific staple.
One action solving two problems. Logical equivalent: Epiwu bime solfi biwu dewe. (One action solves two problems.)
A harmful power laid upon a person or object, persisting against their will.
A large, frightening creature of imagination or legend, typically hostile to humans.
Believing one's small experience is the whole world. Logical equivalent: Daq nojaid cohe zol daq atilui tep daq kani late. (He saw little although he believes he knows all.)
An instrument with a magnetized needle that always points north, used to find direction.
This refers to any of the pieces of hard, whitish tissue making up the skeleton in humans and other vertebrates.
This refers to the amount of money expected, required, or given in payment for something.
A shaped physical covering for the head worn for environmental protection, warmth, or uniform.
This identifies the upper part of the human body containing the brain, eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.
The abstract conceptual faculty by which a mind or system stores, retains, and retrieves informational data.
Indicates the method, process, tool, or pathway utilized to achieve a specific result or destination. (e.g., I learned it via reading).
This verb means to give life to a child or offspring.
This word refers to the hard, protective outer organic layer or exoskeleton naturally secreted and worn by certain animals, such as turtles or mollusks.
A large, heavy biological fruit characterized by a hard green rind and sweet, watery red flesh.
This identifies a living organism that is specifically a land-dwelling beast.
A flat, horizontal board or platform fixed to a wall or in a cupboard, used for holding objects.
The abstract inherent character, fundamental qualities, or conceptual essence of a thing.
First-person singular; the speaker's body and mind.
Strictly belonging to or associated with the speaker.
A structured series of lessons; a program of study.
A biological and cultural grouping of people sharing common descent, history, or language.

This is an immutable mathematical operator used to perform explicit subtraction within a sentence. When placed between two numerical blocks, the parser evaluates the calculation first, unifying them into a single quantitative value before the result looks left to attach to a noun. It can also be used as the subject of a Zero Copula sentence to state a timeless mathematical equation (e.g., raje mis dewe tafe = 5 minus 2 is 3).
Marks a number as negative. Derived from the subtraction operator mis; attaches to a nested-flagged number (e.g. rajem mise = negative five, Rule 25).
This refers to the flesh of an animal used as food.
The standard physical unit of measurement for length or distance.
A bodily sign that indicates a disease (distinct from cacodu, the diagnosis).
A machine equipped with wheels, runners, or an engine, specifically built for transporting people or physical goods over a surface.
This refers to a supreme being, divine creator, or principal object of faith and worship.
To distort the shape of something by turning its ends in opposite directions; to wind or spiral.
This refers to a massive, natural solid elevation of the earth's surface, rising abruptly to a peak from the surrounding ground.
This verb means to increase in physical size, quantity, or maturity over a period of time.
A dense biological collection or large group of trees growing together in a specific area.
This identifies a large plant, typically having a single stem or trunk growing to a considerable height.

Earned positive regard for a person's qualities or standing; a felt attitude, distinct from ezte (polite outward behavior), from suv (grammatical respectful address), and from truhu (awe, reverence mixed with fear).

Deep, object-directed sorrow caused by the loss of a person or cherished entity, as through death or permanent departure. Stronger and more focused than goile (general sadness), and never self-caused like briku (regret).
Not clearly expressed, described, or understood; indefinite.
To concentrate attention or energy on something.
Indicates a spatial or conceptual bridge where the subject is surrounded by, or included as a distinct part of, a larger defined group or set. (e.g., The apple among the grapes).
This refers to the immaterial essence, spiritual core, or animating force of a being, regarded as distinct from both the physical body and the intellectual mind.
A wet, soft, and sticky physical mixture of earth (zaso) and water (dorso).
This word describes an action or concept requiring significant effort, skill, or time to accomplish or understand.
First-person plural inclusive; the speaker, the listener, and potentially others.
Strictly belonging to or associated with the speaker, the listener, and potentially others.
This refers to the seed-bearing part of a plant, consisting of reproductive organs and colorful petals.
A bad event that causes a good result. Logical equivalent: Cemup boke linid isamur gawe. (The bad thing caused a good result.)
An organized series of actions aimed at achieving a particular goal.

This is an immutable mathematical operator used to perform explicit multiplication within a sentence. When placed between two numerical blocks, the parser evaluates the calculation first, unifying them into a single quantitative value before the result looks left to attach to a noun. It can also be used as the subject of a Zero Copula sentence to state a timeless mathematical equation (e.g., tafe mux dewe sluqe = 3 times 2 is 6).
Indicates that the subject is holding the object inside it; specifies content rather than purpose.
A conceptual framework or abstract mathematical representation used to simulate, describe, or predict a system.
This refers to each of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.
An abnormally high body temperature, often an immune response to an illness.
A legendary giant reptile with wings and claws, often depicted breathing fire.
This verb means to perform labor, professional tasks, or exert effort to produce a result.
This describes entities existing or acting in conjunction, unity, or close physical/logical association.
To hold firmly to a demand or assertion; to press a point despite resistance.
This word describes an action or concept achieved without great effort; presenting zero or very few obstacles.
First-person plural exclusive; the speaker and others, explicitly excluding the listener.
Strictly belonging to or associated with the speaker and others, explicitly excluding the listener.
This word describes something existing in or caused by biology or the physical universe; not manufactured by human or artificial intervention.
This refers to a living organism of the kind exemplified by trees, shrubs, and herbs.
This identifies a physical compound, preparation, or substance strictly used for the treatment, cure, or prevention of biological disease.
A word or expression naming a particular thing, especially a technical one.
A collection of musical recordings issued together as a single work.
This refers to a person whom one knows and with whom one has a bond of mutual affection.
Coming immediately after the current one in a sequence or in time (e.g. next week, next person). Generalizes beyond fitydu (tomorrow), which covers only day-distance.
The rhythmic beat of the heart felt in the arteries.
This refers to a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.
A device that restores energy to a battery.
Determined by chance alone, without pattern, plan, or predictability.
A colored liquid used for writing, drawing, and printing.
This verb means to rest with the body supported by the buttocks or thighs; to occupy a seat.
Phatic reply acknowledging thanks; conveys 'you're welcome / no need.' Standalone on the Null Track (Rule 33).
An expression of praise for an achievement or good wishes on a special occasion.
Describes a biological entity mathematically lacking the ability to perceive visual data.
A thick woven fabric covering used on a floor.
Strict logical operator of negation (boolean NOT); standalone negative interjection.
Indicates a logical bridge of absence or the explicit lack of an accompanying object or trait.
A slender wildflower with an intensely blue head, once common in grain fields.
A feeling of revulsion or profound disapproval aroused by something unpleasant or offensive.
A public area of land kept for recreation and nature.
This word identifies a band or bundle of fibrous tissue in a biological body that has the mechanical ability to contract, producing movement or maintaining position.
A wheeled motor vehicle for carrying a few passengers.
An obligation to pay or do something, typically financial, owed to another entity.
To move food, drink, or saliva from the mouth down the throat into the stomach.
A tapering orange root vegetable eaten raw or cooked.
A compulsory payment levied by government on income, goods, or activity.
To drag a hard, sharp, or rough implement across a surface, typically to clean, smooth, or remove material.
Indicates a spatial bridge where the subject is located at or directed toward the forward-facing exterior of a reference point.
The abstract conceptual function assumed or part played by a person or thing in a particular situation.
Extra money given voluntarily for good service.
This refers to a human being, individual, or member of the human species.
This identifies the organ of sight in humans and animals.
To observe an entity or event attentively over a continuous period of time.
Used for direction or position lower than a reference.
Having authority or formal sanction.
This verb means to put food into the mouth, chew, and swallow it as a fundamental biological action.
A pragmatic mood tag indicating the speaker knows the statement is true through logical deduction or physical evidence.
This identifies a fully grown male human being.
This identifies a fully grown female human being.
A secret plan by a group of people to do something unlawful, harmful, or deceitful.
An available asset or means — materials, people, or funds — drawn on to achieve something.
This refers to the arithmetical symbol denoting the absence of all magnitude or quantity.
Used for the present moment.
This refers to the current day.
This word describes something containing nothing or having no occupants.
A conceptual course or abstract principle of action adopted or proposed by a governing body or business.
To work together toward a shared goal.
This refers to a father or mother, or a person or animal that produces offspring.
A weapon with a long metal blade and a hilt, used for cutting or thrusting.
A purple variety of quartz, valued as a gemstone. Follows xaqbo (gold) as a specific mineral/gem type.
The abstract information, meaning, or subject matter contained within a document, speech, or medium.
A complete grammatical sequence of words expressing a full statement, question, or command. Follows go (word) as the next unit up in Fiwo's own linguistic vocabulary.
The assembly that makes a nation's laws.
To physically support the weight of a load and transport it from one location to another.
This identifies the part projecting above the mouth on the face of a person or animal, used for smelling.
The daily event of the sun appearing above the horizon.
To pay for the temporary use of something owned by another.
A small, colonial social insect of the family Formicidae.
The abstract systematic enterprise that builds and organizes knowledge in the form of testable, logical explanations.
Not genuine; imitation or counterfeit (specifically physical or abstract imitation).
Describing an event or state that happens incredibly quickly and entirely without warning or expectation.
A thick, heavy, and highly strong physical cord created by twisting or braiding smaller threads or fibers together.
Kept hidden from others; confidential or clandestine.
A painful feeling of humiliation, distress, or dishonor caused by consciousness of wrong behavior.
The abstract knowledge, familiarity, or practical wisdom gained from observing or undergoing events.
A piece of absorbent cloth or paper used for drying things or oneself.
Not occurring very often; uncommon, exceptional, or hard to find.
An abstract statement deliberately intended to deceive or misrepresent reality.
Logically incorrect or factually inaccurate.
The systematic, conceptual investigation into materials and sources to establish new facts.
A physical design or object worn or displayed to represent a person, group, or idea.
To cause a physical object or abstract message to be conveyed to a separate destination.
To actively grow, tend to, or farm biological crops or plants.
Describes a numerical value, state, or quantity that is close to the referenced benchmark but not exact.
The act of breaking trust, being disloyal, or working secretly against one's country, group, or a person.
To apply friction or pressure to a surface by moving something back and forth over it.
Something so strange that no explanation can be named; stronger than gyke (weird). Logical equivalent: Ram gykei huhe. Nofa nes eksapli luge ram. (It is extremely weird. One cannot explain it.)
To move a spoon or other implement around in a liquid or other substance in order to mix it thoroughly.
To speak very softly using one's breath rather than vocal cords to prevent others from hearing.
A rounded swelling body: the glass envelope of an electric lamp, or the round underground bud of a plant.
Attacking someone already defeated. Logical equivalent: Nofap wafrid. Daq satsid dal. (The person lost. He still hit them.)
A single reproductive unit of fungi, ferns, and mosses.
A small piece of paper or card showing that the holder is entitled to travel, enter a place, or participate in an event.
To cook food quickly by moving it continuously in a small amount of hot oil over high heat.
An abstract numerical quantity or value assigned to represent achievement, performance, or a result in a test or game.
Capable of causing illness, injury, or death when introduced into or absorbed by a living organism.
This refers to the cardinal direction corresponding to the point where the sun sets, oriented to the left when facing north.
This refers to the cardinal direction corresponding to the point where the sun rises, oriented to the right when facing north.
A place or state of great suffering; the underworld of torment in myth and religion.
The state of accepting a situation because nothing can be done about it (Mandarin wunai). Logical equivalent: Daq nes solfi luge jormup. Daq dzefi ram. (He cannot solve the situation. He accepts it.)
To chemically or physically alter food matter for consumption by systematically applying thermal energy.
This word identifies a physical, biological disorder, infection, or abnormal condition that actively disrupts the physiological function and tissue of a living organism.
Describes an entity that is distinct from, different than, or remaining outside the specific entity currently being referenced.
A long, very thin flexible strand of fiber structurally used for sewing, tying, or weaving.
Compassion, pity, or forgiveness shown toward someone whom it is within one's power to punish or harm.
Phatic expressing sympathy, dismay, or concern at bad news; 'oh no / that's awful.' Standalone on the Null Track (Rule 33).
To complete a physical or conceptual journey and successfully transition into a final destination.
At all times; uninterruptedly or on every occasion.
The part of the body that connects the head to the torso.
A utensil with two or more prongs, used for lifting food to the mouth or holding it in place while cutting.
To mathematically exhaust, exchange, or use up a measurable resource, such as time or money.
An abstract conceptual plan of organized work, an enterprise, or a specific targeted undertaking.
A pocket-sized, flat folding case for holding money and cards.
To actively arrange entities, systems, or events into a structured and logical order.
To actively maintain a barrier that keeps an entity or system safe from physical harm or logical corruption.
To feel or express a strong hope or longing for a specific outcome or reality, often one that is not immediately or easily attainable.
To fill a physical space, consume a duration of time, or hold a specific position.
To examine something in detail to understand its parts and structure.
Molten rock, glowing and fluid with extreme heat, found underground or flowing from volcanic openings.
A thin, flat physical material manufactured from processed pulp, used primarily for writing, printing, or structural packaging.
To transfer money or abstract value in exchange for goods or services.
Deliberately not interfering; letting events take their natural course. Logical equivalent: Daq dogi tep cemu je linuci. (He lets things happen.)
A male biological relative who is the brother of one's parent.
To have a specific action, use, or outcome in mind as one's plan or purpose.
This refers to physical suffering or discomfort; a distinct sensory experience of hurting or emotional suffering.
This refers to a written or printed work consisting of pages bound together, or a digital equivalent, used to store information.
An abstract systemic belief, behavior, or cultural practice passed down continuously through generations.
A specified day identified within the calendar.
Indicates that the main action must conclude strictly prior to the referenced temporal baseline or event.
The abstract, continuous, and systematic record or study of past events.
This describes the savory or meaty taste sensation, characteristic of broths and cooked meats.
This verb means to experience an emotion or sensation.
The abstract sensory or conceptual experience of profound positive enjoyment, satisfaction, or physical gratification.
This refers to the male parent of a biological offspring.
This refers to the capacity or ability to direct or influence the behavior of others or the course of events.
To bend something flexible over on itself so that one part of it covers another.
A device that converts sound into an electrical signal.
Clausal wall introducing a direct result, consequence, or logical conclusion.
A massive, abstract conceptual paradigm shift, or the forcible systemic overthrow of a government (govnu) or social order.
This refers to vibrations that travel through the air or another medium and can be heard when they reach a person's or animal's ear.
To pay out money in exchange for goods or services.
This verb means to separate and expel waste matter from the body.
A rigid border or structure that encloses, holds, or displays something.
This describes an event or action occurring at a subsequent time relative to the current baseline.
This refers to a highly specialized physical building or institution providing medical and surgical treatment for sick or injured people.
To inform someone in advance of an impending danger, threat, or problem.
Living; possessing biological life.
Able to be obtained, used, or accessed.
This word indicates that one thing resembles another or shares common characteristics without being identical.
This describes the taste sensation characteristic of acids, like lemon juice or vinegar.
This identifies each of the hard, white structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing.
The fact or state of having committed a specified or implied offense, crime, or moral wrong.
A mechanical or electronic fastening device constructed to physically secure a door or container until opened by a key or code.
This verb means to move toward a specific location or the speaker.
A generic unit of money or currency; a monetary denomination that can be counted. Specific named currencies use Tier-2 borrowings (e.g. euro-o).
Any small, round, juicy fruit without a stone, growing on bushes or vines; the general term of which grapa (grape) is one kind.
This word describes an entity lacking sufficient resources, wealth, or structural quality to maintain a comfortable baseline.
This word refers to a specific physical location or spatial coordinate that is distant or removed from the speaker's current environment.
The abstract conceptual state of harmony, tranquility, and the complete mathematical absence of conflict.
This refers to the fine thread-like strands growing from the skin of humans, mammals, and some other animals.
This word identifies an infective biological agent—typically consisting of nucleic acid within a protein coat—that is only able to multiply within the living cells of a host.
Mildly cold in a pleasant way; a middle temperature between jabe (cold) and ripe (hot), on the cold side of fyjebe (warm).
Exhibiting the color of a ripe orange or the setting sun; a blend of red and yellow.

This acts as a structural pivot within a numerical sequence. It explicitly signals to the parser that the whole integers have stopped, and any digits following it are to be read sequentially as fractional values. The parser reads the entire sequence, including the decimal pivot, as a single quantitative block until the final -t stacker is dropped.
This refers to the cardinal number equivalent to one thousand times one million.

A conceptual point, a specific item/node on a list, or an abstract degree. (If you are referring to a physical, drawn dot on a piece of paper with ink, you would derive it into the concrete noun potuo).
A structural particle used to introduce an event or action happening concurrently with another.
This verb means to direct one's mind toward someone or something or to form ideas.
This refers to the abstract sequence of images, ideas, emotions, and sensations that occur involuntarily in the mind during sleep.
A large brown seaweed that grows in underwater forests.
A charge required for a service or right.
The dark red edible root of the beet plant.
An organized store of data that can be searched.
Indicating the starting point of a period of time that continues to the present (temporal).
The rounded back part of the foot, below the ankle.
The formal examination of a legal case in court.
A strong desire to know, learn, or investigate something.
A machine that reproduces text or images onto paper.
This describes something commanding a low monetary price or requiring very little exchange of financial value.
This refers to a stout-bodied, omnivorous domesticated mammal with sparse bristly hair, kept primarily as livestock.
A cylinder of wax or tallow with a central wick that is burned to provide light.
A tall tropical tree native to dense rainforest regions.
The joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans and other vertebrates.
A state of complete confusion, lack of order, or randomness.
Lacking in manners; impolite, offensive, or disrespectful.
A thin, straight length of rigid material, longer and typically sturdier than a stick.
To make a conscious effort to hear; to pay attention to sound.
The structural top covering of a building (foiso) or the interior upper surface of an enclosed room.
This refers to the cardinal number equivalent to the sum of four and one.
Friday; the fifth day of the week. Derived by compounding raje (five) and du (day).
Third-person singular inanimate; strictly an object, concept, plant, machine, or entity lacking agency.
Strictly belonging to or associated with an inanimate object, concept, or machine.
This word describes something able or likely to cause harm or injury.
This word describes a state possessing physical or conceptual qualities that are highly unpleasant, dissonant, or aesthetically repulsive.
The abstract social behavior, institutions, and conceptual norms transmitted across human societies.
An abstract conceptual framework or system of ideas intended to explain a specific phenomenon or justify a practice.
A distinctive manner of doing, making, or expressing something.
This identifies a brewed, dark physical liquid beverage prepared from the roasted and ground seeds (beans) of the coffee plant.
A computer that supplies data or services to others over a network (distinct from kupmia, the person).
The abstract conceptual connection, tie, or ongoing association between two or more entities, concepts, or people.
To remain in the exact same physical location or conceptual state for an extended duration.
This refers to a particular position, point, or area in space, regardless of whether it is occupied.
To feel sustained hostile rejection toward a specific entity; the antipode of tazi (love). Stronger and more enduring than neuqu (momentary disgust) or tsake (anger at a single act).
A thin, pointed projectile shot from a bow.
This refers to a continuous time period consisting of seven days.
This refers to the cardinal number equivalent to the sum of six and one.
Sunday; the seventh day of the week. Derived by compounding rete (seven) and du (day).
To reverse course and go back to a previous physical location or baseline abstract state.
Situated at a great distance from; far away relative to a reference point.
A person who holds the highest executive, administrative, or directing position within an organized group, government, or system.
Rock or mineral from which metal or valuable material can be extracted.
The bony framework of the head that encloses and protects the brain; the connected head-bones of meka forming the structure of meota.
This word describes an entity possessing a great deal of money, assets, or an abundant supply of resources.
The abstract economic concept of an abundance of valuable possessions, resources, or financial value.
This word describes something having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.
A panel of keys used to input text and commands into a computer or other electronic device.
Coming immediately before the current one in a sequence or in time (e.g. previous week, previous meeting). The antonym of navere (next); generalizes beyond wecdu (yesterday).
Unable to pay one's debts; financially ruined.

words.english: To get up / To rise/ to ascend / Wake
words.def: To actively move oneself from a lower physical position to a higher one (such as standing up from a bed or chair), or for a celestial body to ascend.
Moving, operating, or occurring at a low speed.
This describes a biological state of discomfort caused by a lack of fluids, coupled with a strong desire to drink a liquid.
This word describes something that is in accordance with fact or reality.
The delivery of medicine into the body through a needle.
This defines the absence of light or the state of being without illumination.
This verb means to take a liquid into the mouth and swallow it.
This describes an action or state being repeated or occurring another time.
Inline mathematical boolean OR; offers a choice between elements of the same grammatical category.
A pragmatic mood tag indicating the speaker knows the statement is true because they were told by someone else or read it somewhere.
This word describes a state demanding careful consideration or strict application; not joking or trifling.
Clausal wall presenting an alternative choice or independent clause.
This word describes something having a great or specified extent from side to side.
A common wildflower with a yellow head that turns into a round puff of wind-borne seeds.
The connector inserted to make an electrical connection.
To guide, direct, or mathematically precede others in a physical sequence or organizational structure.
This describes a surface that is uneven or irregular, often coarse or not smooth to the touch.
A heavy device dropped to hold a vessel or structure in place.
This refers to a period of time historically corresponding to a lunar cycle or a standard calendar division.
A vessel or seam that carries flow through a body or through rock (blood vein, ore vein).
A witness's formal account of what they saw.
Of a device or system: switched off and not operating.
A curved piece of metal or wood used for catching, holding, or hanging something.
This word describes something having an edge or point that is able to cut or pierce.
To turn or spin something around a central axis, without changing its shape.
To direct attention to something; to indicate.
This word describes something moving or capable of moving at high speed.
Indicates strict ownership, legal possession, or belonging.
To take something in and hold it, so that it no longer passes through or acts on what lies beyond.
The main upward-growing support of a plant.
A reduction from the normal price.
Used for a position external to the boundaries of an enclosure or object.
The prevailing style of dress or behavior at a given time; trends.
Acknowledges presence or initiates a social interaction.
This refers to a loose, granular physical substance consisting of finely divided rock, mineral particles, or earth.
This verb means to create, construct, or form something.
To physically create, design, or conceptually originate something that did not previously exist.
A gender-neutral biological relative who shares one or both parents with another individual.
To perceive the flavor of food or liquid in the mouth.
This verb means to deliver a blow to someone or something.
A hard black mineral formed from ancient plant matter, dug from the ground and burned as fuel.
This refers to a female sibling who shares one or both parents with another individual.
The flat, sharpened cutting part of a knife, sword, or tool.
This verb means to cease an action or event.

A structural particle that explicitly separates sequential items in a list or breaks the -t stacker bond between adjacent number blocks. It acts as a phonetic wall, telling the parser to finalize the current item and move to the next. Used for enumerating individual multi-digit numbers (e.g., counting 10, 11, 12) and for listing items without using lan.
A pragmatic mood tag placed at the absolute start of a sentence to introduce a summary or conclusion.
Indicating that an action or state occurs regardless of an obstacle or opposing force.
This verb means to make something more modern or current, or to incorporate the most recent information.
A tall vertical support column of a structure.
This refers to a female spouse within a marital partnership.
This verb means to grasp and support something.
Proximal deictic; the current or immediately preceding clause or concept.
This word identifies a specific physical or conceptual noun that is physically close to the speaker, or currently present in the immediate environment. It must follow the noun it modifies.
To officially facilitate, provide the space for, or preside over an abstract event, meeting, or performance.
The right or ability to enter, use, or reach something.
A long, narrow section of contrasting color or material running across a surface.
The place or thing from which something comes or begins.
This verb means to separate into pieces as a result of a blow, shock, or structural failure.
To tentatively believe something, classically something bad or hidden, on partial evidence; a weak positive lean toward a claim, opposite in direction to iqi (doubt), which leans away.
A fish that inflates its spiny body into a ball when threatened; many kinds are poisonous.
This verb means to determine the behavior or supervise the running of an entity or system.
The abstract conceptual arena or mathematical system of commercial dealings, trade, and economic exchange.
Of a device or system: switched on and operating.
A solid dairy product made from curdled milk (lamso). Follows lamso's Concrete Noun class, like its dairy-product sibling zedro (butter).
To expel air suddenly and involuntarily through the nose and mouth, typically from irritation.
To break down, ruin, or dismantle a physical object or abstract system so completely that it no longer structurally exists or functions.
A device that transmits or receives radio waves.

This describes a quantity, degree, or state that goes beyond what is mathematically necessary, normal, or desirable. (This acts as the strict quantitative counterpart to uzume [enough] and fe [very], explicitly indicating an excess).
A soft, moldable solid substance that melts at low heat, produced by bees or from oils, used for candles, sealing, and coating.
A flat object with a spread, wedge-like shape, waved or spun to move air; also the shape itself, as in coral fans.
This refers to the cardinal number equivalent to the product of two and three.
Saturday; the sixth day of the week. Derived by compounding sluqe (six) and du (day).
A thick insulated bundle of wires carrying power or signal.
Not yet cooked or processed; in its natural, unaltered state. Pairs with food (otanie, cooked) and unprocessed ore/materials.
A flying nocturnal mammal with wings formed from a membrane stretched between its limbs.
To touch with the lips as a sign of affection, greeting, or respect.
To return something to an earlier or original state.

The situation of enabling someone who cannot be compelled: you can give the means, but not the will. Logical equivalent: Suk nyrsi luge kabap zy dorsop bul suk nes lini luge tep kabap roli. (You can carry the horse to the water but you cannot make the horse drink.)
A slender, antlered wild mammal known for speed and grace.
Money returned because goods or services failed.
Containing much moisture in the air.
To set free, let go of, or issue to the public.

The abstract structural system of human relationships, institutions, and shared culture existing together within a broad population. (Broader than canpu [Community], which implies a closer shared identity or local group).
The people inhabiting a particular place or region, considered as a body.
Of, relating to, or operated by electronics; digital.
A soft, flexible physical piece of clothing worn directly on the foot and lower leg to provide warmth and reduce friction inside a shoe.
To actively investigate and successfully find an answer, explanation, or peaceful resolution to a problem or dispute.
An intelligent marine mammal with a streamlined body and a beak-like snout.
Having a sharp, burning, hot, or strong taste.
A pragmatic mood tag indicating the speaker knows the statement is true because they directly experienced it (e.g., saw, heard, or felt it happen).
This verb describes the action of dropping down under the force of gravity.
This refers to the physical structure of a person or an animal, comprising the material substance.
A conceptual structured form of play or a competitive abstract system strictly governed by rules.
Steadfast allegiance and devotion to a person, group, or cause over time; the standing disposition whose single violation is ongu (betrayal). Includes filial devotion toward one's parents (孝).
The soft fleshy side of the face, between the eye and the jaw.
To cut food or other materials into small pieces with repeated sharp blows using a knife or similar tool.
An abnormal defensive reaction to a harmless substance.
A soft-bodied marine animal with eight arms and two long tentacles, able to squirt ink.
To produce the sound and scatter of liquid being struck or disturbed.
Waiting for luck instead of working. Logical equivalent: Daq wastiq kewur. Daq nes naciq. (He is waiting for luck. He is not working.)
This identifies a distant celestial object, consisting of a massive, luminous sphere of plasma, appearing as a point of light in the night sky.
To put enough material into a container or space to occupy it completely.
This verb means to lay hold of something with one's hands or reach.
A structured conceptual narrative or abstract account of imaginary or real events.
A doctor's written authorization for medicine.
A physical sequence of entities arranged sequentially in a continuous line.
This verb means to freely transfer the possession of something to someone.
A thin, flat, broad piece of material; a half-height block.
An abstract social grouping of individuals assembled specifically for cooperative work, a sport, or a shared task.
Within a short time from now; in the near future. A temporal modifier, deferred to this batch by the Q8 ruling on temporal adjuncts.
To render text or speech from one language into another, preserving meaning.
To lose consciousness briefly from weakness.
To reverse a previous action or restore something to its prior state; to undo. As a serial-verb primary (Rule 15), it reverses the secondary verb: stuzygi asmkit = to untie.
Highly probable or likely to happen.
This verb means to exert force on something to move it away.
This verb means to rotate or change the direction of movement.
A dead body reanimated into mindless motion; the walking dead of folklore.
Second-person singular; strictly the listener.
Strictly belonging to or associated with the listener.
A substance used to add or change the color of a material.
A flat, physical display surface on an electronic device constructed to emit light and show visual information.

The formal second-person singular pronoun used to show respect when addressing elders, authorities, strangers, or in professional contexts. Possessive form: `suve` (your/yours, formal singular). Pluralized with `je`: `suv je` (you all, formal), possessive `suvem je` (your/yours, formal plural).
Strictly belonging to or associated with the formal/respected listener (possessive of suv, Rule 35).
A thick, smooth, semi-liquid substance.
This verb means to move something into a specific place or position.
The clear physical liquid excreted through the pores of the skin, typically functioning to regulate biological heat.
Indicating that the specified entity is not included in the statement.
The positive release felt when a feared or anticipated bad outcome fails to occur; the resolving counterpart of kuri (fear) and juhi (worry).
This refers to the unit of reproduction of a flowering plant capable of developing into another such plant.
This refers to a structure or place serving as a dwelling, providing protection from the elements and a living space for habitation.
Marks a theoretical premise or conditional clause (if/when/whenever).
An abstract requirement, prerequisite, or stipulation that must be met.
The state of feeling weary, restless, or uninterested due to lack of activity or stimulation.
This refers to the cardinal number that is the sum of one and two.
Wednesday; the third day of the week. Derived by compounding tafe (three) and du (day).
A gain that does not cover its loss. Logical equivalent: Xeskiup landei jete taly wafriup. (The gain is smaller than the loss.)
A conceptual social gathering or a political faction organized for a specific shared purpose.
A feeling of discontented or resentful longing aroused by someone else's possessions, qualities, or luck.
Used to establish a structural bridge between a modified subject or action and the baseline it is being measured against.
This word describes something of considerable size, extent, or capacity.
This refers to a massive, continuous physical body of saltwater that covers a vast structural portion of a planet's surface.
A sweet, crystalline physical substance naturally derived from plants, used strictly to sweeten food or drink.
The specific physical location of the speaker or the immediate area being occupied.
This refers to a male sibling who shares one or both parents with another individual.
To return to health after illness or injury.
To feel deep affection, unconditional care, or profound attachment toward an entity.
This describes an entity or state that stands out above all others in a specific context; to a distinctly higher degree than is usual.
The joint and surrounding area where the leg meets the torso, at the side of the pelvis.
To devote time and attention to acquiring knowledge on an academic subject.

words.english: end of subordinate clause / close bracket
words.def: Closing bracket finalizing a subordinate or conditional clause. Optional at sentence boundaries (periods), but strictly mandatory mid-sentence or to resolve mirroring/nesting ambiguity.
A portable electronic device for two-way audio (and data) communication across a distance; a telephone or mobile/cell phone.
Opening bracket introducing a subordinate or embedded relative clause. Open brackets are implicitly closed by a period (.) at the end of a sentence.
A highly specific, brief abstract conceptual point or period in the flow of time.
This refers to a physical aromatic liquid beverage prepared by pouring hot water over cured or fresh leaves of a plant.
Closes a social interaction or indicates departure.
A woody plant smaller than a tree (mosa), with many stems branching from near the ground.
To go beyond a limit, amount, or expectation.
The time of fading light after sunset.
A large, round, orange-fleshed vegetable with a thick rind, harvested in autumn.
An official document granting permission to do something.
The distant line where the sky appears to meet the land or sea.
This word describes a state of feeling regret or penitence for an action.
Used for direction or position higher than a reference.
To elevate an entity to a higher physical altitude or scale it to a higher mathematical level.
An open area of ground, especially grassland or cleared land used for crops or grazing; the physical place, where atobu is the abstract field of study.
A female biological relative who is the sister of one's parent.
To temporarily give or provide something to someone with the explicit expectation that it will be returned.
A shape or figure formed by two lines or bars intersecting at right angles; also used as a symbol or marker.
This identifies the primary front surface of a biological entity's body, located strictly between the neck and the stomach.
Willing, virtuous endurance of hardship — active, unlike ixovi (endure passively; Mandarin chi ku). Logical equivalent: Daq dzefi pamup. Daq xygaji. (He accepts the pain. He continues.)
To officially create, start, or set up an abstract organization, business, or systemic institution.
Phatic toast exchanged when drinking together; 'cheers.' Standalone on the Null Track (Rule 33).
The abstract study, concept, or collective state of the mind and its cognitive processes.
One of a pair of organs in the abdomen that filter waste products from the blood and produce urine.
To have enough money or means for something.
Agitation arising from a blocked goal or thwarted effort. The obstacle, rather than a moral wrong, distinguishes it from tsake (anger).
A feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.
The joint connecting the foot to the leg.
This describes a strong subjective state of annoyance, displeasure, or furious hostility.
With high frequency; more than evle (sometimes) but less than ovce (always). Completes the amce–evle–tsenge–ovce frequency scale.
This verb means to go away from a place, person, or thing; to depart.
A lustrous white precious metal, used in jewelry, coinage, and tools. Follows xedo (metal) and xaqbo (gold) as a specific metal type.
This refers to a state of happiness and satisfaction.
This verb means to try to find something by looking or otherwise seeking carefully and thoroughly.
To add ornamentation to an object in order to improve its appearance.
To produce a sudden loud impact sound, as of striking, knocking, or falling.
A secret payment made to corrupt someone's judgment.
A rigid container, typically constructed of glass or plastic, featuring a narrow neck and used for storing liquids.
To make or become different; to transform the state of something.
A long, pointed tooth used to seize prey or inject venom.
The coldest season of the year, characterised by short days, low temperatures, and dormant vegetation.
This describes the taste sensation characteristic of sugars.
A written statement of money owed for goods or services.
Indicates physical contact with and support by a surface.
This describes the substance things are made of and is critical for defining modern concepts like plastic.
A single standard quantity, or a distinct grouped whole.
Belonging to or characteristic of the hot, humid regions near the equator.
To mentally anticipate or logically regard an event as highly likely to happen.
Done, perceived, or existing in open view; open to the community.
Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of achievements, qualities, or possessions.
A young plant, especially one recently grown from a seed.
A utensil consisting of a small, shallow oval bowl on a handle, used for eating, stirring, or serving food.
A small disc or knob sewn onto a garment, used to fasten it or as decoration.
Fitting closely; held or closed firmly in place.
The abstract conceptual state, outward visual presentation, or visible aspect of how an entity looks and is perceived by an observer.
A physical or digitally recorded string of text, symbols, or audio meant to convey information from one entity to another.
To move back and forth or up and down with short, quick, repetitive movements.
A serious disagreement, argument, or clash between opposing forces, ideas, or entities.
To accidentally lose or admit contents (typically fluid) through a hole, crack, or defect.
A relative degree modifier indicating the lowest perceptible amount of a trait, state, or action; almost not at all.
A strong desire to do, achieve, or accomplish something great, typically requiring determination.
A piece of cloth or fabric, usually rectangular, with a distinctive design used as a symbol or signal (specifically representing a nation or group).
A situation involving exposure to danger, harm, or loss.
To form an opinion or conclusion about something, or to formally decide a case in a court of law.
A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.
This describes a quantity representing exactly one of two equal parts of a whole (50%).
The circumstances, background, or setting that form the environment for an event, statement, or idea.
To put forward a conceptual idea, abstract plan, or possibility for another mind's consideration.
To greet someone in a warm, friendly, and hospitable manner upon their arrival.
A specific digital tool or concrete software program designed to perform a distinct function for the user on a device like a phone or computer.
A soft, low, dense green plant that carpets damp surfaces.
A soft cushion used to support the head, especially when sleeping in bed.
Not the same in quantity, size, degree, value, or status.
A large bird of prey with a curved beak and long, broad wings.
To make something longer or wider by pulling it, or to extend one's limbs.
To direct one's gaze or visual attention in a specific direction.
An abstract mark, gesture, or object that represents an idea, sound, word, or command.
A gesture, action, or sound that is used to convey information, instructions, or commands.
To make musical sounds with the voice, especially words with a set tune.
This describes an entity moving continuously in one direction without curving, bending, or deviating structurally.
This verb means to rest with eyes closed in a state of natural unconsciousness.
This preposition indicates the ordinal position or sequence of a noun within a series.
To rest or move slowly on or near the surface of a liquid without sinking, or drift in the air.
Any of the five terminal digits of the foot.
A bulbous vegetable with a pungent smell and taste, used in cooking.
Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; relaxed or detached.
The abstract accomplishment of an aim, purpose, or favorable outcome.
To pursue and capture or kill wild animals for food or sport.
This word describes a quantity or degree that is mathematically sufficient or adequate to satisfy a baseline need or demand.
A building or room where books are kept for reading, study, and borrowing.
A device emitting a narrow, intense beam of light.

words.english: Handle / Deal with / Manage / Administer / Be responsible for
words.def: To actively direct, manage, administer, or take organizational/disciplinary action regarding a situation, problem, or entity; to bear responsibility for it (conscientiously).
Hurrying that destroys the thing being grown. Logical equivalent: Buxeup skumki moriup. (The impatience destroys the growth.)
A cinematic work that tells a story through moving images.
An abstract set of circumstances or a specific moment in time that makes it possible to do something favorable.
The event of one celestial body hiding another from view.
To advance, move forward logically, or progress systematically toward a goal or higher state.
A structural particle used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously.
The primary organ of respiration in humans and many other animals, used for gas exchange.
This describes something having a small vertical extent or measuring a short distance from bottom to top.
Introduces a completely new, independent clause that occurs simultaneously alongside the previous clause, or presents a direct contextual contrast (whereas).
A hard gray stone that produces sparks when struck against steel.
The emotional response to a sudden, unexpected (odaze) event. Neutral in valence — it may be positive or negative — unlike truhu (awe), which is reverential.
The internal organ that filters the blood and processes nutrients and toxins.
The abstract conceptual state and overarching condition of the atmosphere at a specific place and time.
To have the courage to execute an action despite fear or risk.
This describes a psychological state of facing danger, pain, or difficult situations despite the presence of fear.
To heat a liquid until it reaches its boiling point and turns into vapor.
A portable source of steady light, whether a burning brand or a fueled or electric lamp.
Describes an action or entity that proceeds in a straight logical sequence without any interruption, intermediaries, or secondary steps.
A very large herbivorous mammal characterized by a long trunk, tusks, and large ears.
A single written or spoken symbol representing one sound in the alphabet. Follows go (word) as a smaller linguistic unit.
The abstract period of time at the end of the day, strictly occurring between late afternoon (fohu) and full night (dugu).
A cylindrical open container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or loose materials.
The season of renewal following winter, characterised by warming temperatures, lengthening days, and the growth of new vegetation.
A small rodent characterized by a pointed snout, large ears, and a long, thin tail.
A dry substance of fine, loose particles, produced by grinding, crushing, or settling; finer than sanpo (sand).
Having or showing an intense, selfish desire for wealth, power, or food.

words.english: To be willing to / To consent to
words.def: To have a favorable disposition, readiness, or uncoerced agreement to perform an action.
This describes a mathematically smaller quantity, extent, or degree of something.
A place or state of supreme happiness; the celestial realm of the afterlife in myth and religion.
A thin, short length of wood, typically a broken or cut branch.
What a person is morally or legally required to do.
To coat a surface with a thin glassy layer that hardens smooth and shiny, as on pottery (dzoco) or food.
A model or guide used to reproduce a shape, design, or structure accurately.
To catch and hold by means of a concealed device, so that escape is prevented.
A social group united by kinship, custom, and territory.
An illustration, diagram, or picture accompanying a text.
A hollow, cup-shaped metal object that makes a ringing sound when struck.
Indicates the physical substance or material composition of the subject.
A small starchy grain, a global staple food, harvested from a cultivated grass. Follows the arteta/zoba (fruit/vegetable) pattern for raw plant food.
Lacking strong flavor, spice, or intensity.
A tailless amphibian with a short, squat body, long hind legs for leaping, and webbed feet.
A piece of furniture with a flat top, typically with drawers, designed for writing, reading, or working.
A strong, regular, repeated pattern of movement or sound.
To break free from confinement, danger, or control.
Indicates that a plural subject is performing an action upon one another.
To cease to have or possess something (an object, a contest, or an opportunity); to be deprived of, or to be defeated.
This word describes something easy to mold, cut, compress, or fold.
Interrogative clause variable for a reason or cause.
This refers to the direction or side towards the west when facing north; the side of the body which contains the heart in most humans.
The collective physical conditions, objects, or abstract circumstances surrounding and influencing an entity.
This describes a surface that is level and smooth, with no raised areas or indentations.
This word describes something that has existed for a long time.
A female biological relative who is the mother of one's parent.
A gender-neutral biological relative who is a parent of one's parent.
A male biological relative who is the father of one's parent.
To remain in a state of paused action in strict anticipation of a specific future event or time.
Interrogative variable for a thing or matter.
An arc of colors appearing in the sky when sunlight passes through rain.
To actively move one's biological body to exert energy, maintain health, or engage in physical recreation.
This word describes something lacking the power to perform physically demanding tasks.
A closed path around which electric current flows.
The organized armed forces of a nation.
This refers to the previous day that has elapsed.
This word describes something as subjectively being satisfactory, correct, or proper.
The abstract temporal realm encompassing all time and recorded events that have already elapsed.
The long-term pattern of weather in a region.
The space between two intersecting lines; specific geometric properties.
To stop someone in the middle of an action, speech, or process.
To give money or goods freely to a person or cause.
A structure consisting of two parallel sidepieces joined by steps or rungs, used for climbing up or down.
This word describes a shape that is circular, spherical, or cylindrical; having a curved surface with no sharp corners.
A solid or hollow spherical physical object designed to roll, bounce, or be thrown in games and sports.
Interrogative variable for a location.
Indicates the action reflects back onto the doer, or emphasizes the exact identity of a specific noun/pronoun.
A recording of moving images.

Confident reliance on a person's future conduct or honesty; interpersonal and agent-directed, unlike ednu (faith in a doctrine or the divine). The standing attitude whose violation is ongu (betrayal).
To firmly press or compress something, typically to extract liquid or change its shape.
A designed opening in a wall or vehicle, typically fitted with transparent glass, built to let in light and air.
An alcoholic physical liquid beverage produced by mathematically fermenting fruit, grains, or biological plant matter.
Interrogative variable for time.
A hard, brittle, transparent solid substance engineered by fusing sand with soda and lime, used for windows or vessels.
Interrogative variable for the manner, method, or degree of an action or state.
This refers to the property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects or emits light.
This word identifies a modified forelimb or specialized biological appendage that enables an organism to fly or glide through the air.
A starchy edible tuber, a global food staple.
This refers to a feeling of expectation and desire for a certain thing to happen; a state of optimism.

The destined affinity that brings particular people together — interpersonal, unlike jyhu (general destiny; Mandarin yuanfen). Logical equivalent: Jyhup lini tep nofa je karxi dal je. (Destiny causes people to find each other.)
This refers to a burrowing, limbless, soft-bodied invertebrate biological organism.
Interrogative subject variable for a non-agent — a thing or event filling SVO Slot 1 (e.g. What happened? What fell?). The inanimate counterpart of wun (who).
The buildings, equipment, and services provided for a particular activity or purpose.
A defined conceptual, political, or geographic division of space, land, or territory.
This word describes something measuring a small distance from end to end.
To remove something completely so that it no longer exists in its medium.
An exclamation of positive surprise, wonder, or amazement.
A weapon consisting of a long shaft with a pointed head, thrust or thrown.
To shape or force something straight into a curve or angle.
Tricking oneself; hiding a truth from oneself. Logical equivalent: Daq caqui daq wible. (He tricks his own self.)
An interrogative variable specifically holding the place of an unknown numerical quantity or mathematical amount. It sits directly in the SVO slot where the numerical answer is expected.
A physical or digital visual diagram representing an area of land or sea, detailing physical geographic features or routes.
This word describes something free from moisture or liquid.
Interrogative variable for a person or agent.
A structure built by a bird, insect, or other animal to hold its eggs or young.
A hard construction material made by mixing cement, sand, gravel, and water, which sets into a stone-like mass.
To produce the soft rushing sound of air, or of something moving fast through it.
Used for accompaniment or instrumentality.
This word describes something protected from or not exposed to danger or risk.
A substance used with water for washing, bathing, and cleaning, typically made from natural oils or fats.
A raised level surface; a stage or base on which things operate; (computing) a system on which applications run.
This describes the natural, perceptible kinetic movement of air  traveling across an environment.
This identifies a large, naturally flowing body of liquid water continuously moving along a path toward a sea, lake, or ocean.
For all future time; eternally, everlastingly.
Pellets of frozen rain or ice that fall in showers from cumulonimbus clouds.
To physically move past an object, or to successfully transfer completely through a structural barrier.
This verb means to change position or displace something.
A pragmatic mood tag placed at the absolute start of a sentence to introduce an example or illustration.
A highly valuable, naturally occurring yellow metal historically used for currency or decoration.
This word describes something that is easy to perceive, understand, or see through without physical obstruction or logical ambiguity.
This describes a solid material that is typically hard, shiny, and conductive.
This refers to a nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.
To perform an activity repeatedly in order to acquire or improve a skill.
A moral or legal entitlement to have or obtain something, or to act in a certain way without interference.
This verb means to propel something with force through the air.
To achieve victory, succeed, or finish first in a competitive system or conflict.
Phatic laughter token conveying amusement; 'haha.' Standalone on the Null Track (Rule 33).
To state or declare that one will definitely do or not do a specific action.
A hoard of valuable objects, especially one hidden, buried, or long sought.
Exhibiting a vivid purplish-red color between leupe (red) and luoke (purple).
A broad, solid piece of metal, wood, or synthetic material held to block or deflect physical blows and projectiles.
A formal meeting or gathering for discussion, typically with an agenda.
A separate piece of furniture designed as a seat for one person, typically featuring a backrest and four legs.
To change chemically through the action of yeast or bacteria, as in brewing or souring.
A competition to determine who is fastest over a set course.
Statements that do not agree with each other, especially one's own. Logical equivalent: Gesiu je daqe nes dzefi. (His statements do not agree.)
To produce a sharp, sustained s-like sound, as a snake, a cat, or escaping air does.
To move instantly from one location to another without crossing the space between.
This describes something commanding a high monetary price or requiring a large exchange of financial value.
The quality of being amusing, comic, or funny, especially as expressed in speech or action.
A concrete electronic device or machine used to receive and display broadcasted moving images and sound.
To go to see and spend time with a person or place as a social or purposeful call.

words.english: In other words / That is to say
words.def: A structural particle used to introduce an explanation, clarification, or rephrasing of a previous statement.
The forward-projecting bony part of the lower jaw, below the mouth.
This refers to a domesticated ruminant mammal characterized by a thick woolly coat, typically kept in flocks for its wool or meat.
This verb means to allow access, passage, or view through a space.
A physical geographic location, building, or structured area where multiple distinct shops, stalls, or vendors are grouped together for commerce.
An organized cultural, artistic, or demonstrative event presented specifically for an audience to observe.
A category of entities having some common characteristics that distinguish them from others.
The distinct sound produced by a person's vocal cords, used in speaking, singing, or communicating.
This refers to each of the two upper limbs of the human body from the shoulder to the hand.
The abstract feeling of being thankful and showing appreciation.
To send data from a device to a remote system.
A large cold-water sea fish, widely caught as a staple food fish.
This verb means to consume or damage something by fire.
To excuse, forgive, or pardon someone for a minor social transgression or interruption.
Indicates that the subject shares the physical geometry or outline of the object, but not necessarily its material or function.
To perform, execute, or carry out a general action.
To persist in an ongoing activity or state without breaking the SVO track.
This word describes something with a small distance between opposite surfaces.
A reptile with a hard protective shell covering its body, living on land or in water.
A common gray-black metal, used for tools, construction, and alloyed into steel. Follows xedo (metal) and xaqbo (gold) as a specific metal type.
This refers to a physical building or retail space structurally dedicated to the commercial selling of goods or services.
A small water bird with a broad flat bill and webbed feet, kept domestically or found in the wild.
The tough outer protective covering of the woody stems and roots of trees.
A small, slender fly that feeds on blood and can transmit diseases.
Describes a state, conclusion, or action that is mathematically, logically, or socially obvious, natural, and completely without doubt.
This refers to the opening in the lower part of the human face through which food is taken in and speech is emitted.
Describes a physical substance that produces a highly positive, pleasurable response when processed by the taste receptors.
A relative degree modifier indicating a medium, average, or partial amount of a trait, state, or action.
An action or omission that constitutes a severe offense punishable by law.
A flexible container made of fabric, leather, or plastic, used structurally for carrying or consolidating other physical items.
The structured indoor ground surface of a room or building on which people stand or walk.
This refers to a small invertebrate animal, often with a segmented body and legs.
The abstract activities, affairs, and systemic processes associated with making decisions within groups, particularly regarding the distribution of power and resources in a government (govnu).
To place an entity out of sight or prevent it from being found.
An organized conceptual framework or set of interacting principles forming a complex whole.
A white crystalline physical mineral consisting of sodium chloride, used to season or preserve food.
This term refers to the ground, soil, or the physical land surface.
Exhibiting a bright, light green color, like young leaves in spring. A pale, vivid shade of luare (green).
This describes something having a great vertical extent or measuring a long distance from bottom to top.
To regard something with pleasure and wonder.
A soft dairy product made by churning milk (lamso) fat. Follows lamso's Concrete Noun class, like its dairy-product sibling skroqo (cheese).
This verb means to put something on top of or in front of something else to protect or conceal it.
The abstract conceptual provision of what is necessary for the health, welfare, or protection of an entity.
The daily event of the sun sinking below the horizon.

Topic marker. Placed at the absolute start of a sentence, it opens a topic phrase ('as for X / regarding X'); the wall 'can' (or 'pen') then closes the topic and hands off to the main clause (Rule 32.5).
Concerning, regarding, or strictly relating to the subject of a specific topic.
This refers to the cardinal number equivalent to the product of three and three.
One specific form or edition of something that exists in successive or parallel variants.
Phatic greeting used in the evening; 'good evening.' Standalone on the Null Track (Rule 33).
One of the Earth's great continuous landmasses.
Known about by many people; widely celebrated or recognized.
A concrete physical building or structural institution where money is legally kept, invested, or exchanged.
A decorative edge or border added to an object for ornamentation.
A hard, lustrous white sphere formed inside a shellfish, valued as a jewel.
An open lattice or skeletal support structure: frameworks, grids, trellises, scaffolding.
To actively produce a ringing or chiming sound, as a phone or bell.
The front part of a biological entity's head, typically containing the eyes, nose, and mouth.
A body of people who meet to decide or advise.
A marine organism that builds hard, branching, stone-like colonies on the sea floor.
This refers to the edible, biological matter of a plant—such as the leaves, stems, or roots—cultivated specifically for nutritional consumption.
This describes an entity or environment producing a high volume of auditory energy or intense sound.
Indicates a spatial bridge where the subject enters one side of an environment, medium, or enclosure and exits the other.
Introduces a concessive clause; it acts as a structural wall indicating that the fact in this clause makes the information in the next clause surprising, contrasting, or unexpected.
To remove an outer layer (bark, skin, paint) from a surface.
To temporarily propel a physical body upward into the air using a sudden application of kinetic force.
Indicates a spatial or logical bridge placing the subject directly in the interval that separates two distinct entities.
The season between summer and winter, characterised by cooling temperatures, shortening days, and the shedding of leaves.

To exist; to be present in reality. A bare existential verb for stating that something is, used where the copula hi cannot apply (it requires a suffix) and the Zero Copula cannot (it requires a complement).
A general, ongoing rise in prices across an economy.
This refers to a piece of furniture or a prepared spot used for sleep or rest.
Financial assets or wealth available for use in producing more wealth.
A tool with a broad blade and handle, used for digging and moving loose material.
A medical operation that cuts into the body to repair it.
A precise step-by-step procedure for solving a problem.
This refers to a method, style, or custom of doing something.
Used for direction toward a destination or outcome.
An area sheltered from direct light.
This verb means to employ something for a particular purpose.
A person who flies a plane; a pilot.
Made of, resembling, or relating to plane.
Stative: to be or become so.
Characterized by or relating to sense; sensible.
Made of, resembling, or relating to claw.
Stative: to be or become generous.
The quality or state of being generous; generosity.
Lying or oriented across something; transverse.
To move across; to cross, traverse.
A person who trades; a trader.
Characterized by or relating to consciousness; conscious.
Characterized by or relating to degree; gradual.
To be positioned diagonally.
The quality or state of being diagonal; diagonality.
Made of, resembling, or relating to umbrella.
A person who crawls; a crawler.
Made of, resembling, or relating to ash.
Characterized by or relating to economy; economic.
Characterized by or relating to mistake; erroneous.
A person who glues; a gluer.
Tending toward, or involving, the action 'glue'.
Made of, resembling, or relating to drought.
Stative: to be or become almost.
Stative: to be or become smelly.
The quality or state of being smelly; stench.
Made of, resembling, or relating to cart.
A person who roasts; a roaster.
A person who shouts; a shouter.
An instrument for, or physical result of, 'shout'.
Standing in place of another; substitute, stand-in.
Stative: to be or become never.
Stative: to be or become early.
Stative: to be or become basic.
The quality or state of being basic; fundamentality.
Stative: to be or become late.
Stative: to be or become satiated.
The quality or state of being satiated; satiety.
Made of, resembling, or relating to apple.
Stative: to be or become normal.
The quality or state of being normal; normality.
Stative: to be or become male.
The quality or state of being male; masculinity.
A person who participates; a participant.
Stative: to be or become should.
Stative: to be or become pregnant.
The quality or state of being pregnant; pregnancy.
Made of, resembling, or relating to lightning.
A person who flows; an one that flows.
An instrument for, or physical result of, 'flow'.
Made of, resembling, or relating to fruit.
A person who practices or is characterized by art.
Characterized by or relating to art; artistic.
Stative: to be or become female.
The quality or state of being female; femininity.
Characterized by or relating to reason; rational.

lines.fiwo: Olma gesid tep Jas.
lines.english: Olma said: "Yes."

lines.english: He said: "And I will say it in a strong voice."

lines.english: She understood that this was not a lie.

lines.english: Many people sat there that morning.

lines.english: He looked at his hands.

lines.english: Talpu sat at the first table.

lines.fiwo: Daq ikuar ry govnup.

lines.fiwo: Das ukwiap.

lines.fiwo: Wenku noqsar waske.
lines.english: Wenku is an old man.

lines.english: He was seventy-five years old.

lines.fiwo: Nirva gesid tep Kop suv kixilkui.

lines.fiwo: Wenku gesid tep Dury jaru gloket dewet.

lines.fiwo: Talpu kupid tep Kup suv usid dury dugup usy tafe?

lines.fiwo: Wenku gesid tep Nes. Mik nes usi gawe.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Mik rizid bef mik gugid ky wilop mike.

lines.fiwo: Talpu kupid tep Kup suv upycid wat?

lines.fiwo: Wenku gesid tep Bip mik nes upycid. Mik pywid.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Sop wiranop skagid.

lines.fiwo: Talpu kupid tep Kup ram linucid dury wiq?

lines.fiwo: Wenku gesid tep Dury gomup usy lere dugue.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Sop mik upycid clapop mike.

lines.english: Hemra asked: "Did you see that face on that night, or did you see it on the days after it?"

lines.fiwo: Daq nes gesid dury dionur joze.

lines.english: The room waited.
