lines.fiwo: Dal je nojapid noky zasop kad dal je pozid zety gidup.
lines.english: They looked down at the ground, because they were thinking about money.

lines.fiwo: Vela kupid nofar tep Kup nevonor zovi ky wer?
lines.english: Vela asked someone: “Where is there a park?”

lines.fiwo: Daq hadid tep Mik nes kani tel bef daq xalid.
lines.english: He answered: “I do not know,” and he moved on.

lines.fiwo: Bexop letseid bef Vela nes lugeid majit wece.
lines.english: The air was filthy and Vela could not breathe properly.

lines.fiwo: Das sejid.
lines.english: She stopped.

lines.fiwo: Das pozid tep Jurop jedi bogur bul mosap jedi mur.
lines.english: She thought: “The city has power, but the tree has a soul.”

lines.fiwo: Das retibid zy fikop.
lines.english: She turned back to the path.

lines.fiwo: Kep das nes fabid gidur. Das fabid bexor jotse juwe.
lines.english: Here is the fact of it: she did not want money. All she wanted was clean air.

lines.fiwo: Mik jedid nauxar tep cenid hemy sydop mike.
lines.english: I had a friend who lived near my house.

lines.fiwo: Hisup dale Kai.
lines.english: His name is Kai.

lines.fiwo: Muk garid nafike jaru jedle.
lines.english: We played together for many years.

lines.fiwo: Kai fabid tep daq nacis deky jurop tande.
lines.english: Kai wanted to work in a big city.

lines.fiwo: Mik pozid tep sil ladur ratse.
lines.english: I thought that this idea is dangerous.

lines.fiwo: Mik gesid tep Cysmop muke kabcei bul ram wydei.
lines.english: I said: "Our village is simple but it is safe."

lines.fiwo: Kai hadid tep Mik koci nojapit dodup.
lines.english: Kai answered: "I need to see the world."

lines.fiwo: Du tep Kai tsid tel goileid.
lines.english: The day that Kai left was sad.

lines.fiwo: Mik nyrsid zabato je daqe zy atripop.
lines.english: I carried his bags to the train.

lines.fiwo: Muk grunkid wable.
lines.english: We hugged each other.

lines.fiwo: Atripop tsid bef mik itse nekid ky wyrofop.
lines.english: The train left and I sat alone on the platform.

lines.fiwo: Mik nes kanid tep mik nojapis Kai romve.
lines.english: I did not know whether I would see Kai again.

lines.fiwo: Retadu je xalid.
lines.english: Weeks passed.

lines.fiwo: Mik jopxid ufaxop tep Kai jamid.
lines.english: I received the letter that Kai wrote.

lines.fiwo: Ufaxop gesid tep Jurop tandei fe bef nofa je jedle ceni tapo.
lines.english: The letter said: "The city is very big and many people live here."

lines.fiwo: Kai jamid tep daq fycisi cysmop.
lines.english: Kai wrote that he misses the village.

lines.fiwo: Mik erfid tep tsiup muilei.
lines.english: I understood that leaving is difficult.

lines.fiwo: Mik jamid tep mik xogris daq dury kynup.
lines.english: I wrote that I would visit him during the summer.

lines.fiwo: Kynup ovamid.
lines.english: The summer arrived.

lines.fiwo: Mik xalid zy jurop tep Kai cenid deky tel.
lines.english: I travelled to the city that Kai lived in.

lines.fiwo: Muk enconid ky wyrofop bef muk hatzid.
lines.english: We met on the platform and we smiled.

lines.fiwo: Relxup muke nes tumid.
lines.english: Our friendship had not changed.

lines.fiwo: Gutoiar hobe hicid deky jurop cape.
lines.english: A young engineer walked through the dark city.

lines.fiwo: Hisup dase Sena.
lines.english: Her name is Sena.

lines.fiwo: Gejedop my jurop kimugid dury tusup rivahe.
lines.english: The city’s electricity had died the winter before.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je cenid deky rokup jaru bime.
lines.english: People had lived in the dark for a year.

lines.fiwo: Sena karxid foisor waske hemy xadorop.
lines.english: Sena found an old building near the river.

lines.fiwo: Hoxop juceid bul das xosid ram.
lines.english: The door was heavy, but she opened it.

lines.fiwo: Krulop jabeid bef paelo je zovid ty zasop.
lines.english: The room was cold and papers lay on the floor.

lines.fiwo: Das leocid viketsop dase.
lines.english: She lit her torch.

lines.fiwo: Panor waske cenid ty degop.
lines.english: An old book sat on a table.

lines.fiwo: Das kilid ram bef das xosid ram roase.
lines.english: She touched it and she opened it slowly.

lines.fiwo: Gop je deky panop gykeid.
lines.english: The words inside the book were strange.

lines.fiwo: Das nes erfid fiwop fose.
lines.english: She did not understand that language.

lines.fiwo: Vax das nes sejid.
lines.english: But she did not stop.

lines.fiwo: Das nekid ty xiolop bef das cimid lokit.
lines.english: She sat on the chair and she began to read.

lines.fiwo: Das lokid dury dugu je jedle.
lines.english: She read through many nights.

lines.fiwo: Das jamid gop byceve ty paelor jaxke.
lines.english: She wrote down every word on fresh paper.

lines.fiwo: Foly retadu je gloke das cimid erfit.
lines.english: After four weeks she began to understand.

lines.fiwo: Panop eksaplid fator waske my pedur tande.
lines.english: The book explained an old machine of great power.

lines.fiwo: Sena gesid tep Kep mik lugei foisoit fatop sile.
lines.english: Sena said: “I can build this machine — I am certain of it.”

lines.fiwo: Das zylid xedor lan gofor lan lyfror.
lines.english: She used metal and wood and wire.

lines.fiwo: Naciup muileid fe.
lines.english: The work was very hard.

lines.fiwo: Das nes usid dury dugu je tafe.
lines.english: She did not sleep for three nights.

lines.fiwo: Fatop cimid dury cihup.
lines.english: The machine started in the morning.

lines.fiwo: Ram pesuid bef litop plid.
lines.english: It made a sound, and the light came.

lines.fiwo: Jurop locweid romve.
lines.english: The city was bright again.

lines.fiwo: Cada je gefrid fy sydo je bef dal je hatzid.
lines.english: Children came out of the houses and they laughed.

lines.fiwo: Sena nekid hemy fatop bef das nojapid litop.
lines.english: Sena sat beside the machine and she watched the light.

lines.fiwo: Hap das kypeid.
lines.english: She was happy.

stories.title: Ibalup ry Nofap waske (The Lesson of the Old Person)

lines.fiwo: Nauxap my Kian otmaid dury tusup.
lines.english: Kian’s friend fell ill during the winter.

lines.fiwo: Daq usid ty zufop bef soxap daqe ripeid.
lines.english: He lay on the bed and his body was burning.

lines.fiwo: Kian kurid fe.
lines.english: Kian was very afraid.

lines.fiwo: Daq cafid zy sydop my nofap waske.
lines.english: He ran to the old man’s house.

lines.fiwo: Daq kupid tep Kup mik xyfi wat? Nauxa mike otmai fe.
lines.english: He asked: “What do I do? My friend is very ill.”

lines.fiwo: Nofap waske nekid roase bef daq stomid tesor ripe zy Kian.
lines.english: The old man sat down slowly and he gave a hot tea to Kian.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Kop suk maji. Kurup nes jofi nauxap suke.
lines.english: He said: “Breathe. Fear does not help your friend.”

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Soxap nes fator vy xedor.
lines.english: He said: “The body is not a machine made of metal.”

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Ram nasar. Nasar koci dionur lan roaseur.
lines.english: He said: “It is a plant. A plant needs time and slowness.”

lines.fiwo: Kian kupid tep Kup mik koci nasbor tande?
lines.english: Kian asked: “Do I need a powerful medicine?”

lines.fiwo: Nofap waske hadid tep Nes. Suk koci cemu je tafe juwe.
lines.english: The old man answered: “No. You need only three things.”

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Cemup usy bime dorsor.
lines.english: He said: “The first thing is water.”

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Cemup usy dewe batar.
lines.english: He said: “The second thing is food.”

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Cemup usy tafe usiur bef ram fafei jeme.
lines.english: He said: “The third thing is sleep, and that one matters most.”

lines.fiwo: Daq eksaplid tep Syn nofar usi can soxap sapi hedcu je jaxke.
lines.english: He explained: “If a person sleeps, then the body builds new parts of itself.”

lines.fiwo: Kian kupid tep Kup zuwup sile ruzei?
lines.english: Kian asked: “Is this way fast?”

lines.fiwo: Nofap waske hatzid bef daq hadid tep Nes. Ram roasei bul ram dotei.
lines.english: The old man smiled and he answered: “No. It is slow, but it is strong.”

lines.fiwo: Kian retibid zy nauxap daqe.
lines.english: Kian went back to his friend.

lines.fiwo: Daq stomid dorsor bef daq rerbid hemy zufop.
lines.english: He gave him water and he stayed beside the bed.

lines.fiwo: Foly retadu bime nauxap daqe rizid.
lines.english: After one week his friend got up.

lines.fiwo: Kep wogiur nasbor jete taly gutor.
lines.english: Hope is more of a medicine than any tool.

lines.fiwo: Dup ripeid fe bef fevop zaveid.
lines.english: The day was very hot and the sun was high.

lines.fiwo: Nofap nacie foisoidyq sydor vy gofor.
lines.english: A working man was building a house out of wood.

lines.fiwo: Hisup daqe Rem.
lines.english: His name is Rem.

lines.fiwo: Daq kocid gutop daqe tande vy xedor.
lines.english: He needed his big metal tool.

lines.fiwo: Daq xosid hanop daqe bul ram nufeid.
lines.english: He opened his box, but it was empty.

lines.fiwo: Rem kupid wible tep Kup gutop mike zovi ky wer?
lines.english: Rem asked himself: “Where is my tool?”

lines.fiwo: Daq tsytid deky foisop.
lines.english: He searched inside the building.

lines.fiwo: Daq tsytid ty zasop.
lines.english: He searched on the ground.

lines.fiwo: Daq karxid cemu noze.
lines.english: He found nothing.

lines.fiwo: Daq xalid zy nauxap daqe tep hekrid buskor loage.
lines.english: He went over to his friend, who was wearing blue clothes.

lines.fiwo: Daq kupid tep Kup suk nojapid gutop mike?
lines.english: He asked: “Have you seen my tool?”

lines.fiwo: Nauxap pozid roase bef daq hadid tep Mace. Mik nojapid ram hemy fatop.
lines.english: The friend thought slowly and he answered: “Perhaps. I saw it near the machine.”

lines.fiwo: Rem cafid zy fatop tande.
lines.english: Rem ran to the big machine.

lines.fiwo: Gutop nes zovid tapo.
lines.english: The tool was not there.

lines.fiwo: Daq tsakeid.
lines.english: He was angry.

lines.fiwo: Nauxar ase plid bef das gesid tep Cadar stelid gutop suke kad daq fabid garit.
lines.english: A woman friend came over and she said: “A child took your tool, because he wanted to play.”

lines.fiwo: Rem hicid zy mosap.
lines.english: Rem walked to the tree.

lines.fiwo: Daq nojapid cadap tep satsidyq drekop wy gutop.
lines.english: He saw the child, who was striking a stone with the tool.

lines.fiwo: Rem baqid tep Kop suk seji!
lines.english: Rem shouted: “Stop!”

lines.fiwo: Cadap sejid bef daq kurid.
lines.english: The child stopped and he was frightened.

lines.fiwo: Rem majid roase.
lines.english: Rem breathed slowly.

lines.fiwo: Daq nekid hemy cadap bef daq gesid tep Gutop sile nes weoror. Ram ratsei.
lines.english: He sat down beside the child and he said: “This tool is not a ball. It is dangerous.”

lines.fiwo: Cadap nojapid noky zasop bef daq gesid tep Hap mik tocei.
lines.english: The child looked down at the ground and he said: “I am sorry.”

lines.fiwo: Rem hatzid bef daq stomid drekor lande zy cadap.
lines.english: Rem smiled and he gave a small stone to the child.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Kop suk gari wy sil.
lines.english: He said: “Play with this.”

lines.fiwo: Foly sil Rem retibid zy naciup daqe.
lines.english: After that Rem went back to his work.

lines.fiwo: Kep daq nes tsakeid romve.
lines.english: He was not angry any more.

lines.fiwo: Farlopar nacid deky picalop tande.
lines.english: A doctor worked inside a big hospital.

lines.fiwo: Hisup dase Vera.
lines.english: Her name is Vera.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je jedle otmaid dury tusup.
lines.english: Many people fell ill during the winter.

lines.fiwo: Das kupid tep Kup suk paulid wis?
lines.english: She asked: "How do you feel?"

lines.fiwo: Nofar hadid tep Mik paulid boke. Meotap mike pamui.
lines.english: A man answered: "I feel bad. My head hurts."

lines.fiwo: Vera kupid tep Kup sil cimid dury wiq?
lines.english: Vera asked: "When did this start?"

lines.fiwo: Daq hadid tep Dury retadup rivahe.
lines.english: He answered: "During the previous week."

lines.fiwo: Vera kupid tep Kup suk nomid wat?
lines.english: Vera asked: "What did you eat?"

lines.fiwo: Daq hadid tep Mik nomid fubar lan vyflar.
lines.english: He answered: "I ate fish and rice."

lines.fiwo: Vera jamid fulu je.
lines.english: Vera wrote down the details.

lines.fiwo: Das kupid tep Kup suk ceni ky wer?
lines.english: She asked: "Where do you live?"

lines.fiwo: Daq hadid tep Mik ceni hemy xadorop.
lines.english: He answered: "I live near the river."

lines.fiwo: Vera pozid tep dorsop orvei.
lines.english: Vera thought that the water is poisoned.

lines.fiwo: Das kupid tep Kup nofa je wug otmai deky worup suke?
lines.english: She asked: "How many people are ill in your area?"

lines.fiwo: Daq hadid tep Nofa je drabe.
lines.english: He answered: "A hundred people."

lines.fiwo: Nop javuqup ovamid fy dorsop.
lines.english: The infection must have come from the water.

lines.fiwo: Vera baqid stramup dase.
lines.english: Vera called her team.

lines.fiwo: Das kupid tep Kup wun nojapis xadorop?
lines.english: She asked: "Who will go and inspect the river?"

lines.fiwo: Licar hadid tep Mik xalis.
lines.english: A colleague answered: "I will go."

lines.fiwo: Dal je xalid zy xadorop.
lines.english: They went to the river.

lines.fiwo: Dal je karxid fumor lan kezor deky dorsop.
lines.english: They found smoke and oil in the water.

lines.fiwo: Vera kupid tep Kup sil linucid kad wal?
lines.english: Vera asked: "Why did this happen?"

lines.fiwo: Lica dase hadid tep Foisor jaxke ipti kezop zy xadorop.
lines.english: Her colleague answered: "A new building is spilling oil into the river."

lines.fiwo: Vera tsakeid.
lines.english: Vera was angry.

lines.fiwo: Das gesid tep Kop suk je seji foisop.
lines.english: She said: "Shut the building down."

lines.fiwo: Hyp syn foisop nes sejis can nofa je jedle kimugis.
lines.english: Suppose the building does not stop — then many people will die.

lines.fiwo: Govnup dzefid.
lines.english: The government agreed.

lines.fiwo: Foisop sejid dury dup navere.
lines.english: The building was shut down the next day.

lines.fiwo: Vera stomid nasbop zy nofa je otmae.
lines.english: Vera gave medicine to the sick people.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je tatesmid strene.
lines.english: The people recovered soon after.

lines.fiwo: Nofar kupid tep Kup mik pagari gidu wug?
lines.english: A man asked: "How much money must I pay?"

lines.fiwo: Vera hadid tep Noze. Sil framei.
lines.english: Vera answered: "Nothing. This is free."

lines.fiwo: Daq grawid das.
lines.english: He thanked her.

lines.fiwo: Das gesid tep Mik nacid kad mik tazi nofa je.
lines.english: She said: "I do this work because I love people."

lines.fiwo: Nofa je my jurop nembuid das.
lines.english: The people of the city praised her.

lines.fiwo: Femunup falmid zety das.
lines.english: The press reported on her.

lines.fiwo: Das nes fabid jejur.
lines.english: She did not want glory.

lines.fiwo: Das fabid juwe tep nofa je farluei.
lines.english: All she wanted was for people to be healthy.

lines.fiwo: Mortsar tande zovi hemy cysmop my nofa je.
lines.english: A great forest lies near the village of people.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je gesid tep Mortsap sile jedi magustur.
lines.english: People said that this forest holds magic.

lines.fiwo: Cada je nes enrid deky ram.
lines.english: Children did not go into it.

lines.fiwo: Caqlar enrid deky mortsap bimedu.
lines.english: A boy went into the forest on Monday.

lines.fiwo: Hisup daqe Neo.
lines.english: His name is Neo.

lines.fiwo: Daq tsytid saza daqe.
lines.english: He was searching for his sister.

lines.fiwo: Das wafrieid dury dup rivahe.
lines.english: She had gone missing the day before.

lines.fiwo: Neo baqid das igy lere.
lines.english: Neo called her ten times.

lines.fiwo: Hadiur nes ovamid.
lines.english: No answer came.

lines.fiwo: Mosa je my mortsap zavei fe bef cila je dale capei.
lines.english: The trees of the forest are very tall and their leaves are black.

lines.fiwo: Litop nes enrid.
lines.english: No light got through.

lines.fiwo: Neo leocid viketsop daqe.
lines.english: Neo lit his torch.

lines.fiwo: Caflo je xalidyq zory mosa je.
lines.english: Shadows were moving between the trees.

lines.fiwo: Daq pywid pesur gyke.
lines.english: He heard a strange sound.

lines.fiwo: Vuwor zindid rewy daq.
lines.english: A bell rang somewhere far off.

lines.fiwo: Daq emitid pesup.
lines.english: He followed the sound.

lines.fiwo: Daq karxid krulor my dreko je.
lines.english: He found a chamber of stone.

lines.fiwo: Nosanar waske nekidyq deky ram.
lines.english: An old woman was sitting inside it.

lines.fiwo: Das jedid noja je locwe.
lines.english: She has white eyes.

lines.fiwo: Das gesid tep Mik ublidyk suk.
lines.english: She said: "I have been expecting you."

lines.fiwo: Neo kupid tep Kup suk nojapid saza mike?
lines.english: Neo asked: "Have you seen my sister?"

lines.fiwo: Das hadid tep Jas. Das usi deky krulop otre.
lines.english: She answered: "Yes. She is asleep in another chamber."

lines.fiwo: Neo kupid tep Kup mik nyrsi das zy sydop?
lines.english: Neo asked: "May I carry her home?"

lines.fiwo: Nosanap hadid tep Suk stomi fuqe cemur zy mik.
lines.english: The woman answered: "You must give me something."

lines.fiwo: Neo kupid tep Kup suk fabi wat?
lines.english: Neo asked: "What do you want?"

lines.fiwo: Das gesid tep Mik fabi merifur suke.
lines.english: She said: "I want a memory of yours."

lines.fiwo: Neo pozid gomu bime.
lines.english: Neo thought for a full hour.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Mik stomi merifup my cihup tep mana mike uropid tel.
lines.english: He said: "I give you the memory of the morning my mother sang."

lines.fiwo: Nosanap dzefid.
lines.english: The woman agreed.

lines.fiwo: Das kilid meotap daqe.
lines.english: She touched his head.

lines.fiwo: Neo ebnesid lozuxup my mana daqe.
lines.english: Neo forgot his mother's song.

lines.fiwo: Vax daq nes irakid.
lines.english: Even so, he did not cry.

lines.fiwo: Nosanap ruxigid hoxor lande.
lines.english: The woman pointed to a small door.

lines.fiwo: Neo xosid ram bef daq karxid saza daqe.
lines.english: Neo opened it and he found his sister.

lines.fiwo: Das usidyq ty drekop.
lines.english: She was sleeping on the stone.

lines.fiwo: Daq baqid das igy tafe bef das rizid.
lines.english: He called her three times and she woke.

lines.fiwo: Dal je cafid zy hoxop.
lines.english: They ran for the door.

lines.fiwo: Fevop rizidyk.
lines.english: The sun had risen.

lines.fiwo: Mortsap kluxeid romve.
lines.english: The forest was quiet again.

lines.fiwo: Kyfa je uropid.
lines.english: Birds were singing.

lines.fiwo: Saza daqe kupid tep Kup won linucid?
lines.english: His sister asked: "What happened?"

lines.fiwo: Neo hadid tep Noze.
lines.english: Neo answered: "Nothing."

lines.fiwo: Daq nes gesid zety nosanap.
lines.english: He did not speak about the woman.

lines.fiwo: Daq retibid zy mortsap jaru byceve.
lines.english: He went back to the forest every year.

lines.fiwo: Daq baqid nosanap bul das nes hadid.
lines.english: He called for the woman, but she never answered.

lines.fiwo: Kep magustup jedi melfur.
lines.english: It is a fact that magic has a price.

lines.fiwo: Noqsar cenid deky jurop tande.
lines.english: A man lived in a big city.

lines.fiwo: Hisup daqe Ren.
lines.english: His name is Ren.

lines.fiwo: Daq nacid deky zikuzop du byceve.
lines.english: He worked in a bank every day.

lines.fiwo: Naciup daqe nes muileid bul ram sysuid.
lines.english: His work was not difficult, but it bored him.

lines.fiwo: Ren sejid usit dury tusup.
lines.english: Ren stopped sleeping during the winter.

lines.fiwo: Daq nekidyq ty zufop dugu byceve.
lines.english: He sat up on his bed every night.

lines.fiwo: Noja je daqe nes beatid.
lines.english: His eyes would not close.

lines.fiwo: Daq pywidyq pesur lande.
lines.english: He kept hearing a faint sound.

lines.fiwo: Pesup ovamid fy zasop.
lines.english: The sound came from the ground.

lines.fiwo: Ren gesid tep Sil pesup jaxke.
lines.english: Ren said: "This sound is new."

lines.fiwo: Daq kupid nauxa je daqe.
lines.english: He asked his friends about it.

lines.fiwo: Dal je hadid tep Nak nes pywid cemur.
lines.english: They answered: "We do not hear anything."

lines.fiwo: Nop Ren itse pywid ram.
lines.english: Ren alone must have been able to hear it.

lines.fiwo: Daq xalid zy farlopap.
lines.english: He went to the doctor.

lines.fiwo: Farlopap kokidid daq.
lines.english: The doctor examined him.

lines.fiwo: Das gesid tep Soxap suke farluei. Mik nes karxi otmar.
lines.english: She said: "Your body is healthy. I cannot find any illness."

lines.fiwo: Ren nes dzefid.
lines.english: Ren did not accept it.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Cemur zovi noky jurop.
lines.english: He said: "There is something beneath the city."

lines.fiwo: Farlopap hadid tep Suk arife rerbit deky sydop bef suk arife usit.
lines.english: The doctor answered: "You should stay at home and you should sleep."

lines.fiwo: Ren retibid zy sydop bul daq nes usid romve.
lines.english: Ren went home, but he still did not sleep.

lines.fiwo: Retadu tafe xalid.
lines.english: Three weeks passed.

lines.fiwo: Noja je daqe leupeid.
lines.english: His eyes were red.

lines.fiwo: Fuka je daqe ufdidyq.
lines.english: His hands were shaking.

lines.fiwo: Daq nes lugeid guamit gu je.
lines.english: He could not work with numbers any more.

lines.fiwo: Rezap my zikuzop kupid tep Kup won linucid zy suk?
lines.english: The head of the bank asked: "What has happened to you?"

lines.fiwo: Ren hadid tep Mik nes usi.
lines.english: Ren answered: "I do not sleep."

lines.fiwo: Rezap gesid tep Kop suk xali zy sydop.

lines.english: Its eyes were red.

lines.fiwo: Bo kurid bul daq nes cafid.
lines.english: Bo was afraid, but he did not run.

lines.fiwo: Cuskamap kupid tep Kup suk fabi wat?
lines.english: The demon asked: "What do you want?"

lines.fiwo: Bo hadid tep Mik fabi pebar mike.
lines.english: Bo answered: "I want my father."

lines.fiwo: Cuskamap hatzid.
lines.english: The demon laughed.

lines.fiwo: Ram gesid tep Nofa je late fabi cemur. Nofa je late wafri ram.
lines.english: It said: "Everyone wants something. Everyone loses it."

lines.fiwo: Bo stomid lusop zy ram.
lines.english: Bo gave the key to it.

lines.fiwo: Cuskamap kilid lusop.
lines.english: The demon touched the key.

lines.fiwo: Ram gesid tep Sil nes uzumei.
lines.english: It said: "This is not enough."

lines.fiwo: Bo kupid tep Kup suk koci wat?
lines.english: Bo asked: "What do you need?"

lines.fiwo: Cuskamap hadid tep Mik koci merifu je suke.
lines.english: The demon answered: "I need your memories."

lines.fiwo: Bo nes erfid.
lines.english: Bo did not understand.

lines.fiwo: Ram eksaplid tep Suk ebnesis pebap suke bef suk etypis daq.
lines.english: It explained: "You forget your father, and you get him back."

lines.fiwo: Bo nekid ty zasop.
lines.english: Bo sat down on the ground.

lines.fiwo: Daq irakid gomu ulime.
lines.english: He cried for half an hour.

lines.fiwo: Daq pozid zety cihu je wy pebap.
lines.english: He thought about the mornings with his father.

lines.fiwo: Daq pozid zety lozuxu je my mana daqe.
lines.english: He thought about his mother's songs.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Nes.
lines.english: He said: "No."

lines.fiwo: Cuskamap tsakeid.
lines.english: The demon was angry.

lines.fiwo: Dorsop rizid bef ram zemid Bo.
lines.english: The water rose and it closed over Bo.

lines.fiwo: Bo nes majid.
lines.english: Bo could not breathe.

lines.fiwo: Daq nojapid caflor deky dorsop.
lines.english: He saw a shadow in the water.

lines.fiwo: Caflop pebar daqe.
lines.english: The shadow was his father.

lines.fiwo: Peba daqe gesid tep Kop suk xali zy cyxop.
lines.english: His father said: "Go to the shore."

lines.fiwo: Bo dormid tody bysop.
lines.english: Bo swam upward toward the sky.

lines.fiwo: Daq ovamid ty cyxop.
lines.english: He reached the shore.

lines.fiwo: Nosanap waske wastidyq.
lines.english: The old woman was waiting.

lines.fiwo: Das gesid tep Suk pilkei.
lines.english: She said: "You are alive."

lines.fiwo: Bo hadid tep Mik nojapid pebap mike.
lines.english: Bo answered: "I saw my father."

lines.fiwo: Das kupid tep Kup daq gesid wat?
lines.english: She asked: "What did he say?"

lines.fiwo: Bo hadid tep Daq gesid tep Kop suk xali tel.
lines.english: Bo answered: "He said: 'Go.'"

lines.fiwo: Nosanap irakid.
lines.english: The woman wept.

lines.fiwo: Das gesid tep Mik sifa dale.
lines.english: She said: "I am his wife."

lines.fiwo: Bo erfid.
lines.english: Bo understood.

lines.fiwo: Dal je nekid nafike fecy cihup.
lines.english: They sat together until morning.

lines.fiwo: Fevop rizid.
lines.english: The sun rose.

lines.fiwo: Cuskamap nes gefrid romve.
lines.english: The demon never came out again.

lines.fiwo: Bo retibid zy cysmop.
lines.english: Bo went back to the village.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je kupid tep Kup won linucid?
lines.english: People asked: "What happened?"

lines.fiwo: Daq nes hadid.
lines.english: He did not answer.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid juwe tep Brirsop nes ratsei nu.
lines.english: He said only: "The lake is not dangerous now."

lines.fiwo: Cada je cimid dormit deky ram.
lines.english: Children began to swim in it.

lines.fiwo: Bo nes dormid romve.
lines.english: Bo never swam again.

lines.fiwo: Daq nekid hemy dorsop jaru byceve.
lines.english: He sat beside the water every year.

lines.fiwo: Daq baqid pebap daqe.
lines.english: He called for his father.

lines.fiwo: Hadiur nes ovamid bul Bo nes goileid.
lines.english: No answer came, but Bo was not sad.

lines.fiwo: Kep biwu je cuje nes jedi solfiur.
lines.english: It is a fact that some problems have no solution.

lines.fiwo: Crocodile-ar babsem fe cenid wedacu.
lines.english: Long ago there lived a very hungry crocodile.

lines.fiwo: Dal tsytid roase kluxe batar.
lines.english: It searched for food slowly and quietly.

lines.fiwo: Hap crocodile-ap satsi!
lines.english: The crocodile strikes!

lines.fiwo: Dal nes babsei foly fos bef dal kypei.
lines.english: After that it is not hungry, and it is happy.

lines.fiwo: Fecy dionup tep dal babsei romve.
lines.english: Until the time it is hungry again.

lines.fiwo: Iegar usidyq.
lines.english: A lion was sleeping.

lines.fiwo: Vohar cafid ty iegap.
lines.english: A mouse ran on the lion.

lines.fiwo: Iegap sejid usit.
lines.english: The lion woke.

lines.fiwo: Iegap gugid tsake bef fualid vohap.
lines.english: The lion stood up angrily and caught the mouse.

lines.fiwo: Iegap fabid kimarit vohap.
lines.english: The lion wanted to kill the mouse.

lines.fiwo: Vohap kupid tep Syn suv nes kimari mik can mik jofis peze suv.
lines.english: The mouse asked: "If you do not kill me, then I will help you later."

lines.fiwo: Iegap hatzid bef snugipid vohap.
lines.english: The lion laughed and released the mouse.

lines.fiwo: Uzkia je fualid peze iegap.
lines.english: Later, hunters caught the lion.

lines.fiwo: Dal je asmkid ty zasop wy odcano je dote iegap.
lines.english: They bound the lion to the ground with strong ropes.

lines.fiwo: Iegap grorowid.
lines.english: The lion roared.

lines.fiwo: Vohap pywid xucup bef ebzikid ram.
lines.english: The mouse heard the voice and recognized it.

lines.fiwo: Vohap plid bef cotid odcano je wy pixra je.
lines.english: The mouse came and cut the ropes with its teeth.

lines.fiwo: Iegap frameid.
lines.english: The lion was free.

lines.fiwo: Kep vohar lande liene lugei jofit iegap tande.
lines.english: Even a small mouse is able to help a big lion.

lines.fiwo: Obta je nacid dury kynup.
lines.english: The ants worked during the summer.

lines.fiwo: Dal je kiagid syca je.
lines.english: They saved seeds.

lines.fiwo: Grasshopper-ar nes nacid.
lines.english: A grasshopper did not work.

lines.fiwo: Grasshopper-ap lozuxuid late du.
lines.english: The grasshopper sang every day.

lines.fiwo: Dury tusup obta je linid tep syca je wukei.
lines.english: During the winter the ants made the seeds dry.

lines.fiwo: Grasshopper-ap babseidyq.
lines.english: The grasshopper was hungry.

lines.fiwo: Dal plid ky obta je bef kupid batap.
lines.english: It came to the ants and asked for food.

lines.fiwo: Obta je kupid tep Kup suv nes kiagid batap dury kynup kad wal?
lines.english: The ants asked: "Why did you not save food during the summer?"

lines.fiwo: Grasshopper-ap gesid tep Mik lozuxuid bef mik nes nacid.
lines.english: The grasshopper said: "I sang, and I did not work."

lines.fiwo: Obta je hatzid bef gesid tep Suv lozuxuid dury kynup can suv malxi dury tusup.
lines.english: The ants laughed and said: "You sang during the summer, so dance during the winter."

lines.fiwo: Obta je nes stomid batap.
lines.english: The ants did not give food.

lines.fiwo: Kep nofar tep nacid dury kynup tel nomi dury tusup.
lines.english: One who works during the summer eats during the winter.

lines.fiwo: Noqsar hobe hicid ruze deky jurop cape.
lines.english: A young man walked quickly through the dark city.

lines.fiwo: Hisup daqe Vero.
lines.english: His name is Vero.

lines.fiwo: Jurop nufeid. Nofar otre nes zovid.
lines.english: The city was empty. There was no one else.

lines.fiwo: Daq nes kurid kad daq kanid fiko je late.
lines.english: He was not afraid, because he knew every street.

lines.fiwo: Daq tsytid rerpop bef daq karxid hoxor tande vy xedor.
lines.english: He searched the place and he found a great door of metal.

lines.fiwo: Fator waske gugid hemy ram.
lines.english: An old machine stood beside it.

lines.fiwo: Panor cenid ty zasop.
lines.english: A book lay on the ground.

lines.fiwo: Vero stelid panop bef daq lokid ram.
lines.english: Vero picked up the book and he read it.

lines.fiwo: Panop gesid tep Fatop xosis hoxop.
lines.english: The book said: “The machine will open the door.”

lines.fiwo: Vax fatop skagieid.
lines.english: But the machine was broken.

lines.fiwo: Gutoiap tep sapid ram tel tsidyk jaru je jedle.
lines.english: The engineer who built it had left many years before.

lines.fiwo: Vero kilid xedop jabe my fatop.
lines.english: Vero touched the cold metal of the machine.

lines.fiwo: Fatop rizid bef ram kupid tep Kup suk cutwei?
lines.english: The machine woke and it asked: “Are you ready?”

lines.fiwo: Ram gesid tep Kop suk stomi gidu drabe zy mik.
lines.english: It said: “Give me a hundred coins.”

lines.fiwo: Vero nes jedid gidur.
lines.english: Vero had no money.

lines.fiwo: Daq hadid tep Mik nes jedi gidur bul mik gutoiar.
lines.english: He answered: “I have no money, but I am an engineer.”

lines.fiwo: Daq xosid ezlop my fatop.
lines.english: He opened the machine’s cover.

lines.fiwo: Fap lyfrop cotid.
lines.english: A wire had been cut.

lines.fiwo: Daq zylid gutop lande daqe bef daq smotifid ram.
lines.english: He used his small tool and he repaired it.

lines.fiwo: Fatop pesuid romve.
lines.english: The machine sounded again.

lines.fiwo: Hoxop xosid roase.
lines.english: The door opened slowly.

lines.fiwo: Litop enrid deky jurop.
lines.english: Light came into the city.

lines.fiwo: Vero gefrid bef daq nojapid fevop.
lines.english: Vero walked out and he looked at the sun.

lines.fiwo: Kep daq nes retibis zy jurop cape.
lines.english: He will not be going back to the dark city.

lines.fiwo: Foisop mike jedi fato je raje.
lines.english: My building has five machines.

lines.fiwo: Fato je sile nacid du late.
lines.english: These machines ran every day.

lines.fiwo: Fatop usy tafe nes nacid nudu.
lines.english: The third machine did not run today.

lines.fiwo: Fap fatop skagid.
lines.english: The machine had broken down.

lines.fiwo: Mik nes kanid askup.
lines.english: I did not know the reason.

lines.fiwo: Mik itse kokidid fatop.
lines.english: I examined the machine alone.

lines.fiwo: Mik xosid ezlop bef mik nojapid deky ram.
lines.english: I opened the lid and I looked inside it.

lines.fiwo: Drafo je dewe lympid.
lines.english: Two of the wheels had rusted.

lines.fiwo: Fap lyfror cotid.
lines.english: A wire had been cut.

lines.fiwo: Mik gesid tep Biwup sile anazei.
lines.english: I said: "This problem is a basic one."

lines.fiwo: Mik baqid licap mike.
lines.english: I called my colleague.

lines.fiwo: Muk nacid wable.
lines.english: We worked together.

lines.fiwo: Das stomid ivxop zy mik bef mik stomid gutop zy das.
lines.english: She gave me the hammer and I gave her the tool.

lines.fiwo: Muk snugipid drafo je waske.
lines.english: We freed the old wheels.

lines.fiwo: Mik swamid drafo je jaxke deky fatop.
lines.english: I fitted new wheels into the machine.

lines.fiwo: Lica mike jamid falfosor my hedcu je.
lines.english: My colleague wrote a list of the parts.

lines.fiwo: Muk gidsid hedcu je marte.
lines.english: We bought eight parts.

lines.fiwo: Melfup keane gidu drabe.
lines.english: The total price was one hundred coins.

lines.fiwo: Fap fatop smotifid dury fohup.
lines.english: The machine was repaired during the afternoon.

lines.fiwo: Muk leocid ram.
lines.english: We switched it on.

lines.fiwo: Fatop pesuid bef ram xalid romve.
lines.english: The machine made a sound and it moved again.

lines.fiwo: Wox! Muk xeskid.
lines.english: Wow! We had won.

lines.fiwo: Rezap muke ovamid bef daq nojapid fatop.
lines.english: Our boss arrived and he looked at the machine.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Kep suk je nacid wece.
lines.english: He said: "It is a fact that you worked well."

lines.fiwo: Daq pagarid muk gidu drabe.
lines.english: He paid us one hundred coins.

lines.fiwo: Mik kypeid bul mik iweid fe.
lines.english: I was happy but I was very tired.

lines.fiwo: Mik retibid zy sydop bef mik jiprid wible.
lines.english: I went home and I washed myself.

lines.fiwo: Mik usid dugu keane.
lines.english: I slept the whole night.

lines.fiwo: Myrafar cenidyk deky levidzop dury wedacup.
lines.english: A dragon had lived inside a cave long ago.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je my cysmop kurid ram.
lines.english: The people of the village feared it.

lines.fiwo: Zet myrafap can nofa je gesidyq tep ram skumkis cemu late.
lines.english: As for the dragon, the people kept saying that it would destroy everything.

lines.fiwo: Caslar vice cenid deky cysmop.
lines.english: A brave girl lived in the village.

lines.fiwo: Hisup dase Ina.
lines.english: Her name is Ina.

lines.fiwo: Das nes kurid myrafap.
lines.english: She did not fear the dragon.

lines.fiwo: Das gesid tep Mik xalis zy levidzop.
lines.english: She said: "I will go to the cave."

lines.fiwo: Nupa je dase jyqid.
lines.english: Her parents refused.

lines.fiwo: Vax das tsid dury dugup.
lines.english: Even so, she left during the night.

lines.fiwo: Das nyrsid viketsor lan batar lan dorsor.
lines.english: She carried a torch and food and water.

lines.fiwo: Fikop zy montop ratseid fe.
lines.english: The path to the mountain is very dangerous.

lines.fiwo: Das drijid gomu gloke.
lines.english: She climbed for four hours.

lines.fiwo: Xabesop linid tep viketsop coqynid.
lines.english: The wind made the torch go out.

lines.fiwo: Das nes sejid.
lines.english: She did not stop.

lines.fiwo: Das ovamid ky levidzop dury cihup.
lines.english: She reached the cave during the morning.

lines.fiwo: Levidzop tandei fe bef ram rokuei.
lines.english: The cave is very big and it is dark.

lines.fiwo: Myrafap usidyq deky ram.
lines.english: The dragon was sleeping inside it.

lines.fiwo: Ina nes akdid.
lines.english: Ina did not shout.

lines.fiwo: Das swamid batap ky zasop.
lines.english: She set the food down on the ground.

lines.fiwo: Myrafap rizid bef ram nojapid das.
lines.english: The dragon woke and it looked at her.

lines.fiwo: Ram kupid tep Kup hisup suke?
lines.english: It asked: "What is your name?"

lines.fiwo: Ina hadid tep Mik Ina. Mik nes guzar.
lines.english: Ina answered: "I am Ina. I am not an enemy."

lines.fiwo: Myrafap gesid tep Nofa je reslihi mik kad dal je nes kani mik.
lines.english: The dragon said: "People hate me because they do not know me."

lines.fiwo: Kof ram gesid tep Mik nes nomi nofa je.
lines.english: Furthermore it said: "I do not eat people."

lines.fiwo: Ina hatzid.
lines.english: Ina laughed.

lines.fiwo: Xom myrafap kluxei bef ram ecmei.
lines.english: In other words, the dragon is quiet and it is humble.

lines.fiwo: Das rerbid deky levidzop du tafe.
lines.english: She stayed inside the cave for three days.

lines.fiwo: Das kritrid myrafap zety fiwop my nofa je.
lines.english: She taught the dragon about the language of people.

lines.fiwo: Myrafap kritrid das zety xabesop lan fuegop.
lines.english: The dragon taught her about wind and fire.

lines.fiwo: Zet cysmop can nofa je nes kanid tep Ina pilkei.
lines.english: As for the village, the people did not know that Ina was alive.

lines.fiwo: Das retibid dury retadup navere.
lines.english: She came back the following week.

lines.fiwo: Myrafap emitid das.
lines.english: The dragon followed her.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je kurid bul Ina gesid tep Sil nauxa mike.
lines.english: The people were afraid, but Ina said: "This is my friend."

lines.fiwo: Pen pogafup ovamid zy cysmop.
lines.english: So peace came to the village.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je sapidyk gekipror tande.
lines.english: People had built a large satellite.

lines.fiwo: Ram cyridyq zory grexo je.
lines.english: It was flying out among the heavenly bodies.

lines.fiwo: Ocaduap je nacid deky wopyvop ky zidzopop.
lines.english: Scientists worked in a facility on the continent.

lines.fiwo: Gekipror jopxid urfur bimedu.
lines.english: The satellite received a signal on Monday.

lines.fiwo: Urfup ovamid fy stalor tep zovi rewy bucygop.
lines.english: The signal came from a star that lies far from Earth.

lines.fiwo: Tep gekipror jopxid urfur tel veponkur tande.
lines.english: That the satellite received a signal at all was a great surprise.

lines.fiwo: Ocaduap je nes usid dugu keane.
lines.english: The scientists did not sleep the whole night.

lines.fiwo: Dal je pabicid fulup je gomu jedle.
lines.english: They analysed the data for many hours.

lines.fiwo: Urfup jedid gu je sek uqu je sek pesu je.
lines.english: The signal held numbers, symbols and sounds.

lines.fiwo: Ocaduar guamid gu je.
lines.english: A scientist worked through the numbers.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Gu je sile nes negoxrei.
lines.english: He said: "These numbers are not random."

lines.fiwo: Rezap my oxahup gesid tep Kep sil lalupur.
lines.english: The head of the project said: "It is a fact that this is proof."

lines.fiwo: Ocaduap je lan govnup dzefid tep dal je nes falmis zy femunup.
lines.english: The scientists and the government agreed that they would not tell the press.

lines.fiwo: Vax nofar krendid fulup zy gypup.
lines.english: Even so, someone leaked the data to the internet.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je my dodup keane kanid dury dumu je exke.
lines.english: The people of the whole world knew within a few minutes.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je cuje kypeid bul nofa je cuje kurid.
lines.english: Some people were glad, but some people were afraid.

lines.fiwo: Zet urfup can nofa je nes erfid blunup dale.
lines.english: As for the signal, people did not understand its meaning.

lines.fiwo: Ocaduap je ombid hadiur zy stalop.
lines.english: The scientists sent a reply back to the star.

lines.fiwo: Hadiup xalis jaru drabe.
lines.english: The reply will travel for a hundred years.

lines.fiwo: Ocaduar gesid tep Syn hadiup ovamis can muk nes pilkeis.
lines.english: A scientist said: "If the reply arrives, we will not be alive."

lines.fiwo: Vax daq nes goileid.
lines.english: Even so, he was not sad.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Cada je my cada je muke pywis.
lines.english: He said: "The children of our children will hear it."

lines.fiwo: Gekipror jopxid urfur otre dury retadup navere.
lines.english: The satellite received another signal the following week.

lines.fiwo: Urfup jaxke jedid lakiror.
lines.english: The new signal held an image.

lines.fiwo: Lakirop cetofid grexor lan fevor lan nasar tandef.
lines.english: The image showed a world, a sun, and great plants.

lines.fiwo: Nofar my lakirop jedid noja je gloke.
lines.english: The being in the image had four eyes.

lines.fiwo: Ocaduap je kluxeid gomu bime.
lines.english: The scientists were silent for a full hour.

lines.fiwo: Ocaduar irakid.
lines.english: One scientist wept.

lines.fiwo: Daq gesid tep Muk nes itsei.
lines.english: He said: "We are not alone."

lines.fiwo: Nofa je my bucygop nes usid dugu je jedle.
lines.english: The people of Earth did not sleep for many nights.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je cuje kurid bef nofa je cuje wogid.
lines.english: Some people were afraid and some people hoped.

lines.fiwo: Govnu je my xeku je jedle enconid.
lines.english: The governments of many countries met.

lines.fiwo: Dal je sapid glotunur jaxke.
lines.english: They drew up a new treaty.

lines.fiwo: Eru je sejid dury jarup fose.
lines.english: The wars stopped that year.

lines.fiwo: Tep nofa je nafike nacid tel gawei fe.
lines.english: That people work together is a very good thing.

lines.fiwo: Ocaduap je sapid abecor tande tep cyris zory stalo je.
lines.english: The scientists built a great ship to fly between the stars.

lines.fiwo: Naciup fose kocid jaru drabe.
lines.english: That work would take a hundred years.

lines.fiwo: Ocaduar nes nojapis fefup my oxahup daqe.
lines.english: The scientist will not see the end of his project.

lines.fiwo: Vax daq nes sejid.
lines.english: Even so, he did not stop.

lines.fiwo: Daq jamid tep Mik naci cagy nofa je tep plis fituru tel.
lines.english: He wrote: "I work for the people who will come after us."

lines.fiwo: Gekipror haibe cyri zory grexo je.
lines.english: The satellite still flies out among the heavenly bodies.

lines.fiwo: Urfup haibe pli.
lines.english: The signal still comes.

stories.title: II. Lozuxup jedid hiror (The Song With a Hole In It)

lines.fiwo: Fikop locwe nes fikor rodle.
lines.english: The white road is not really a road.

lines.fiwo: Ram stirop my dreko je lande ty facup ostue my Kelvo.
lines.english: It is a line of small stones on the eastern side of Kelvo.

lines.fiwo: Nofar amce sapid ram romve dury jaru je zewet nozet nozet.
lines.english: Nobody has repaired it in nine hundred years.

lines.fiwo: Uropiar juwe hici ty ram bef dal hici igy bime dury ceniup dale.
lines.english: Only a Singer walks it, and only once in a life.

lines.fiwo: Nyra drijid ram dury du dewe.
lines.english: Nyra climbed it for two days.

lines.fiwo: Das nyrsid bryklor bef hanor my dorso.
lines.english: She carried bread and a skin of water.

lines.fiwo: Dorsop kutgid jawor dury dugup usy bime.
lines.english: The water became ice on the first night.

lines.fiwo: Das hekrid buskop taqae tandem slafe.
lines.english: She wore her brother's coat, which was too big.

lines.fiwo: Fos gawe kad das goji luge xufa je dase deky ram.
lines.english: That was good, because she could pull her arms inside it.

lines.fiwo: Jabeup nes cemur tep plid bef tsid.
lines.english: The cold was not a thing that came and went.

lines.fiwo: Ram zovid ky rerpo late dury dionu late piny zasop.
lines.english: It was everywhere, all the time, the way the ground is.

lines.fiwo: Nofar xyfi luge cemup bime juwe.
lines.english: A person can do only one thing.

lines.fiwo: Das ifezid igy gomu late tep das cenis haibe.
lines.english: She decided, every hour, that she would go on being alive.

lines.fiwo: Dury dugup usy dewe ifeziup fose kutgid Nyra.
lines.english: By the second night, that deciding had become Nyra.

lines.fiwo: Das karxid uqu je taqae.

lines.fiwo: Zitsugup sioxid jokuwu dury glokedu.
lines.english: The council sat on Thursday.

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Bip muk fijai ikup.
lines.english: Malka said, "First we hear the law."

lines.fiwo: Malka lokid tep Nofa nes stomi fuqe dorso cagy cyva.
lines.english: Malka read: "A person must not give water to a stranger."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Nofa je gloke emitid ikup. Ikup zovi keane.
lines.english: Malka said, "Four people followed the law. The law stands whole."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Muk nes zovi deky dofemop nudu.
lines.english: Malka said, "We are not sitting in a court today."

lines.fiwo: Onta gesid tep Cyvap kimugid.
lines.english: Onta said, "The stranger died."

lines.fiwo: Malka hadid tep Jas. Bul nofa nes bime cukid jany ikup.
lines.english: Malka replied, "Yes. And nobody broke the law."

lines.fiwo: Onta gesid tep Mik kani.
lines.english: Onta said, "I know."

lines.fiwo: Onta nes gesid romve dury dugup fose.
lines.english: Onta said nothing more that night.

lines.fiwo: Pesku gesid tep Muk tumi mace ikup romve.
lines.english: Pesku said, "We might change the law again."

lines.fiwo: Malka hadid tep Muk jokuwuid ciafe. Muk nes jokuwui romve dury jaru sile.
lines.english: Malka replied, "We have already voted. We do not vote again this year."

lines.fiwo: Halva nes gesid.
lines.english: Halva said nothing.

lines.fiwo: Duro jamid gop je bul das nes lokid gop je.
lines.english: Duro wrote the words and did not read the words.

lines.fiwo: Zitsugup tsid ry krulop.
lines.english: The council left the room.

lines.fiwo: Onta xalid hemy fikop bul das nojaid mosap.
lines.english: Onta walked out to the road and looked at the tree.

lines.fiwo: Onta nekid ky fikop dury getsu tande.
lines.english: Onta sat on the road for a long time.

lines.fiwo: Onta pozid tep das jokuwuid cagy blunu bime.
lines.english: Onta thought that she had voted for one meaning.

lines.fiwo: Onta nes kanid tep das ixovid blunu otre.
lines.english: She did not know she had been handed the other.

lines.fiwo: Fos blunup ry jaru fose.
lines.english: That is what that year meant.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je sluqet nozet cenid ky cysmop bul nofa bime kimugid ky fikop.
lines.english: Sixty people lived in the village, and one man died on the road.

lines.fiwo: Nofa nes bime agcuid.
lines.english: Nobody had done wrong.

lines.fiwo: Ikup zovid.
lines.english: The law had stood.

lines.fiwo: Gop je rete zovid ky gasublop bime.
lines.english: Seven words stood on one page.

lines.fiwo: Nofa nes bime guamid gop je.
lines.english: Nobody had counted them.

lines.fiwo: Vesla pagarid gidu je rajet nozet bul das nes ebnesid fos.
lines.english: Vesla had paid fifty coins, and she had not forgotten it.

lines.fiwo: Vesla fabid tep das kani gop tep linid pizup dase.
lines.english: Vesla wanted to know which word had made her guilty.

lines.fiwo: Vesla xalid ky sydop ry Duro dury glokedu.
lines.english: Vesla went to Duro's house on Thursday.

lines.fiwo: Duro xosid hoxop dase.
lines.english: Duro opened his door.

lines.fiwo: Vesla gesid tep Mik pagarid ciafe. Mik nes cuki jany suk.
lines.english: Vesla said, "I have already paid. I am not quarrelling with you."

lines.fiwo: Vesla gesid tep Mik fabi tep suk loki ikup cagy mik.
lines.english: Vesla said, "I want you to read the law to me."

lines.fiwo: Duro hadid tep Mik loki mace fos cagy suk.
lines.english: Duro replied, "I can read it to you."

lines.fiwo: Vesla gesid tep Kop loki go bime dury getsu bime.
lines.english: Vesla said, "Read one word at a time."

lines.fiwo: Duro xosid panop tande ky gasublop zety jokuwup rivahe.
lines.english: Duro opened the great book at the page about the old vote.

lines.fiwo: Duro lokid tep Nofa. Nes. Stomi. Fuqe. Dorso.
lines.english: Duro read: "Person. Not. Give. Must. Water."

lines.fiwo: Duro nes lokid gop navere wible.
lines.english: He could not read the next word by itself.

lines.fiwo: Duro gesid tep Gop navere nes zovi wible. Fos zovi hemy gop otre hyme.
lines.english: Duro said, "The next word does not stand alone. It always stands beside another word."

lines.fiwo: Duro lokid tep Cagy cyva.
lines.english: Duro read: "To a stranger."

lines.fiwo: Vesla guamid go je apawy mapa je dase.
lines.english: Vesla counted the words on her fingers.

lines.fiwo: Vesla gesid tep Go je rete.
lines.english: Vesla said, "Seven words."

lines.fiwo: Duro hadid tep Jas.
lines.english: Duro replied, "Yes."

lines.fiwo: Vesla nojaid gasublop bul das nes lokid fos.
lines.english: Vesla looked at the page and did not read it.

lines.fiwo: Vesla nojaid gop je rete ky facup wane ry gasublop.
lines.english: She saw seven words on the left of the page.

lines.fiwo: Vesla nojaid gop je rete romve ky facup lyse.
lines.english: She saw seven words again on the right.

lines.fiwo: Vesla kupid tep Kup gop je rete labnei gop je rete?
lines.english: Vesla asked, "Are the seven words the same as the seven words?"

lines.fiwo: Duro hadid tep Jas. Fos nujup ry Onta. Sil ikup.
lines.english: Duro replied, "Yes. That one is Onta's motion. This one is the law."

lines.fiwo: Vesla kupid tep Kup blunu je labnei?
lines.english: Vesla asked, "Do they mean the same?"

lines.fiwo: Duro nes hadid.
lines.english: Duro did not answer.

lines.fiwo: Duro lokid gasublop romve.
lines.english: Duro read the page again.

lines.fiwo: Duro nekid.
lines.english: Duro sat down.

lines.fiwo: Duro nes gesid dury getsu tande.
lines.english: For a long time he said nothing.

lines.fiwo: Vesla kupid tep Kup wun okseid?
lines.english: Vesla asked, "Who was wrong?"

lines.fiwo: Duro hadid tep Mik. Mik jamid gop je.
lines.english: Duro replied, "I was. I wrote the words."

lines.fiwo: Duro lokid tep Nofa stomi nes fuqe dorso cagy cyva.
lines.english: Duro read: "A person does not have to give water to a stranger."

lines.fiwo: Duro lokid tep Nofa nes stomi fuqe dorso cagy cyva.
lines.english: Duro read: "A person must not give water to a stranger."

lines.fiwo: Vesla gesid tep Mik nes fijai blunu je dewe.
lines.english: Vesla said, "I do not hear two meanings."

lines.fiwo: Duro gesid tep Kop pywi facup ry gop bime.
lines.english: Duro said, "Listen to where one word stands."

lines.fiwo: Duro lokid fos romve dury getsu tandem jete.
lines.english: He read it again, more slowly.

lines.fiwo: Vesla gesid tep Mik fijai fos nu.
lines.english: Vesla said, "Now I hear it."

lines.fiwo: Vesla nekid ky facup ry hoxop.
lines.english: Vesla sat down by the door.

lines.fiwo: Vesla gesid tep Mik pagarid gidu je rajet nozet cagy facup ry go bime.
lines.english: Vesla said, "I paid fifty coins for the place of one word."

lines.fiwo: Duro gesid tep Jas.
lines.english: Duro said, "Yes."

lines.fiwo: Vesla gesid tep Cyvap kimugid cagy facup ry go bime.
lines.english: Vesla said, "A stranger died for the place of one word."

lines.fiwo: Duro gesid tep Jas.
lines.english: Duro said, "Yes."

lines.fiwo: Duro guamid go je romve bul das nes tumid fos.
lines.english: Duro counted the words again and did not change them.

lines.fiwo: Duro lan Vesla xalid ky sydop ry Onta dury dugup fose.
lines.english: Duro and Vesla went to Onta's house that night.

lines.fiwo: Onta lokid gasublop dury getsu cohe.
lines.english: Onta read the page for a short moment.

lines.fiwo: Onta nekid ky facup wane.
lines.english: Onta sat down on the left side.

lines.fiwo: Onta gesid tep Mik fijaid ikup dury jaru bime bul mik nes fijaid fos.
lines.english: Onta said, "I heard the law for a year, and I never heard it."

lines.fiwo: Onta gesid tep Mik kanid gop je mike. Fos linid tep mik nes lokid gop je.
lines.english: Onta said, "I knew my own words. That is what stopped me reading them."

lines.fiwo: Duro gesid tep Mik nes kanid tep mik agcuid.
lines.english: Duro said, "I did not know I had made a mistake."

lines.fiwo: Onta hadid tep Mik kani. Mik nes cuki jany suk.
lines.english: Onta replied, "I know. I am not quarrelling with you."

lines.fiwo: Zitsugup sioxid jokuwu dury glokedu navere.
lines.english: The council sat the following Thursday.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je sluqet nozet plid ky krulop tande.
lines.english: Sixty people came to the great room.

lines.fiwo: Malka sioxid.
lines.english: Malka presided.

lines.fiwo: Duro gesid tep Mik jamid ikup okse. Fos geale. Mik gesi fos cagy nofa je keane.
lines.english: Duro said, "I wrote the law wrong. That is true. I say it to everyone."

lines.fiwo: Krulop zodeid.
lines.english: The room grew loud.

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Kop nekid.
lines.english: Malka said, "Sit down."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Tep Duro jamid gop je okse tel geale.
lines.english: Malka said, "That Duro wrote the words wrong is true."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Bul tep muk tumi ikup nudu tel nes hevi cyvap tep kimugid.
lines.english: Malka said, "But changing the law today does not pardon us for the stranger who died."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Nofa je jeme emitid ikup dury jaru bime. Fos jobu je dalem je.
lines.english: Malka said, "Most people followed the law for a year. That was their duty."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Syn muk tumi ikup nudu can muk gesi tep nofa je fose agcuid.
lines.english: Malka said, "If we change the law today, then we are saying those people did wrong."

lines.fiwo: Onta gesid tep Jokuwup ikup. Gasublop krulo cagy ikup.
lines.english: Onta said, "The vote is the law. The page is only a room the law is kept in."

lines.fiwo: Malka hadid tep Kop stomi jokuwup cagy mik.
lines.english: Malka replied, "Hand me the vote, then."

lines.fiwo: Onta nes hadid.
lines.english: Onta did not answer.

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Jokuwup nes zovi nu. Fuka je gloke zovid deky krulop dury getsu cohe bul fuka je tsid.
lines.english: Malka said, "The vote does not exist now. Four hands were in a room for a short while, and the hands went away."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Gasublop zovi. Fos zovis dury jaru je zewet nozet.
lines.english: Malka said, "The page exists. It will exist for ninety years."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Muk nes kani jokuwup. Muk kani gasublop.
lines.english: Malka said, "We do not know the vote. We know the page."

lines.fiwo: Onta gesid tep Fos geale bul fos nes hiqe.
lines.english: Onta said, "That is true and it is not right."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Jas. Fos nes hiqe.
lines.english: Malka said, "Yes. It is not right."

lines.fiwo: Duro gesid tep Mik jami fuqe gop je hiqe. Mik nes jamid gop je hiqe.
lines.english: Duro said, "I am required to write the words correctly. I did not write the words correctly."

lines.fiwo: Duro gesid tep Mik jyqi jobup mike.
lines.english: Duro said, "I give up my office."

lines.fiwo: Malka hadid tep Nes. Nofa nes bime otre jami mace deky cysmop.
lines.english: Malka replied, "No. Nobody else in the village can write."

lines.fiwo: Duro nekid romve.
lines.english: Duro sat back down.

lines.fiwo: Halva nes gesid.
lines.english: Halva said nothing.

lines.fiwo: Pesku gesid tep Muk jokuwui romve nu.
lines.english: Pesku said, "We vote again now."

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Jas. Muk jokuwui apawy gop je labne.
lines.english: Malka said, "Yes. We vote on the same words."

lines.fiwo: Malka lokid tep Nofa stomi nes fuqe dorso cagy cyva.
lines.english: Malka read: "A person does not have to give water to a stranger."

lines.fiwo: Malka lokid fos romve.
lines.english: Malka read it again.

lines.fiwo: Malka kupid tep Kup wun jokuwui cagy nujup?
lines.english: Malka asked, "Who votes for the motion?"

lines.fiwo: Onta lan Pesku lan Duro stomid fuka je dalem je.
lines.english: Onta and Pesku and Duro raised their hands.

lines.fiwo: Malka kupid tep Kup wun jokuwui jany nujup?
lines.english: Malka asked, "Who votes against the motion?"

lines.fiwo: Malka lan Halva stomid fuka je dalem je.
lines.english: Malka and Halva raised their hands.

lines.fiwo: Onta nojaid Halva.
lines.english: Onta looked at Halva.

lines.fiwo: Onta kupid tep Kup suk tumid decup suke?
lines.english: Onta asked, "Have you changed your mind?"

lines.fiwo: Halva hadid tep Jas.
lines.english: Halva replied, "Yes."

lines.fiwo: Halva gesid tep Mik jokuwuid cagy nujup dury jaru rivahe. Mik jokuwui jany fos nu.
lines.english: Halva said, "I voted for the motion last year. Now I vote against it."

lines.fiwo: Onta kupid tep Kup suk jokuwui jany nujup kad wal?
lines.english: Onta asked, "Why do you vote against the motion?"

lines.fiwo: Halva hadid tep Mik beatid hoxop mike cagy cada bime.
lines.english: Halva replied, "I shut my gate on a child."

lines.fiwo: Halva gesid tep Syn ikup tumi nudu can mik agcuid dury jaru bime.
lines.english: Halva said, "If the law changes today, then I did wrong for a year."

lines.fiwo: Halva gesid tep Mik nes fabi fos.
lines.english: Halva said, "I do not want that."

lines.fiwo: Krulop kluxeid romve.
lines.english: The room went quiet again.

lines.fiwo: Duro jamid gop je dalem je.
lines.english: Duro wrote down their words.

lines.fiwo: Duro guamid fuka je.
lines.english: Duro counted the hands.

lines.fiwo: Duro gesid tep Nofa je tafe jokuwuid cagy nujup bul nofa je dewe jokuwuid jany fos.
lines.english: Duro said, "Three people voted for the motion and two voted against it."

lines.fiwo: Jokuwup cagy nujup jetei jete taly jokuwup jany fos.
lines.english: The vote for the motion was greater than the vote against it.

lines.fiwo: Jokuwup fose coheid jete taly jokuwup rivahe.
lines.english: That vote was narrower than the earlier one.

lines.fiwo: Nujup tumid ikup romve.
lines.english: The motion changed the law again.

lines.fiwo: Zitsugup nes stomid gidu je rajet nozet romve cagy Vesla.
lines.english: The council did not give Vesla back her fifty coins.

lines.fiwo: Malka gesid tep Ikup rivahe zovid. Vesla pagarid apawy fos.
lines.english: Malka said, "The earlier law stood. Vesla paid under it."

lines.fiwo: Cyvap tep kimugid ky fikop tel nes zovi romve.
lines.english: The stranger who died on the road does not come back.

lines.fiwo: Duro jamid ikup jaxke ky panop tande.
lines.english: Duro wrote the new law into the great book.

lines.fiwo: Onta zovid hemy Duro bul das nojaid gop je.
lines.english: Onta stood at Duro's shoulder and watched the words.

lines.fiwo: Duro jamid tep Nofa stomi nes fuqe dorso cagy cyva.
lines.english: Duro wrote: "A person does not have to give water to a stranger."

lines.fiwo: Onta lokid gop je bime dury getsu bime.
lines.english: Onta read the words one at a time.

lines.fiwo: Onta gesid tep Jas.
lines.english: Onta said, "Yes."

lines.fiwo: Zitsugup jamid aziku jaxke ky gasublop navere.
lines.english: The council wrote a new rule on the next page.

lines.fiwo: Azikup jaxke gesi tep Nofa dewe loki fuqe gop tep nofa bime jami.
lines.english: The new rule says: Two people must read what one person writes.

lines.fiwo: Fos aziku bime tep zitsugup jamid dury jaru fose tel bul fos zovi nu.
lines.english: That is the only rule the council wrote that year, and it is still standing.

lines.fiwo: Domlop plid dury retadu je dewe navere.
lines.english: The rain came two weeks later.

lines.fiwo: Ciswop ry cysmop gizei romve.
lines.english: The village's barrel was full again.

lines.fiwo: Agsop nes zovid.
lines.english: The drought was over.

lines.fiwo: Nofa nes bime kupid dorso ky hoxo je dury jaru navere.
lines.english: Nobody asked for water at a gate for another year.

lines.fiwo: Ikup jaxke zovi ky panop ry Duro bul nofa nes bime loki fos.
lines.english: The new law is in Duro's book, and nobody reads it.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je nes ebmeri jokuwu je dewe.
lines.english: People do not remember the two votes.

lines.fiwo: Nofa je ebmeri jaru fose.
lines.english: People remember that year.

lines.fiwo: Vesla nes loki mace bul das ebmeri facup ry go bime.
lines.english: Vesla cannot read, and she remembers where one word stood.
